quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: I, too, was once kept in someone's heart like you. Those trivial moments, when looked back upon, are worth more than a thousand words... The past shapes who we are today. Some things are hard to remember, others hard to forget.

quotes.title: About Firefly
quotes.text: In her, I see the fireflies of the forest, dazzling and bewitching, yet shining only for a brief moment.

quotes.title: About Black Swan
quotes.text: A lady of elegance and dignity, her benevolent offer lingers in my memory. That dance... it brought me a sense of warmth and nostalgia.

quotes.title: About Aventurine
quotes.text: A shattered emptiness draped in the guise of desire... his existence is strikingly powerful, yet the self beneath is extraordinarily faint.

quotes.title: About Welt
quotes.text: There are many types of people called "heroes," and he is among the most genuine... I have seen many such people come and go.

quotes.title: About Sam
quotes.text: Wherever the fiery giant treads, scorched earth follows. Yet, it's those consumed by unending fire... who, after the flames vanish, quietly hold the ashes in their lonesome embrace.

quotes.title: About Boothill
quotes.text: Galaxy Ranger... His affiliation with the organization is merely a cover. It's evident that he lives only for himself, and that is exactly why I have faith in him.

quotes.title: About The Dahlia
quotes.text: She dances at the edge of death and takes delight in it while she consorts with the Nihility. She desires nothing, and perhaps that is how she can bloom so carefree.

quotes.title: About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon
quotes.text: Many people born in this era view faith as the only thing in their lives, and the prophecies of the three are able to soothe this anxious and restless world like a gentle rain.

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: Accepting others' wishes and turning them into his own wishes — not all heroes are such blank canvases as him, and that is why the world places such great hopes on him.

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: He's like a furnace, always lit with bottomless fire. This fire will either completely be doused in a storm, or melt down his own existence with it.

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: The one closest to death often knows the most about how precious life is. Her embrace brings eternal sleep, but such farewells are always warm.

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: I do not agree with the ideals of that blasphemer, but we are the same when it comes to the determination with which we seek our dreams.

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: Her color is gentle and unique among the Chrysos Heirs' portraits, soft as the lightest breeze and bright as the first rays of dawn. Amphoreus's sky had been dark for too long, and it's time for her to grant the world her healing light.

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: I have lost much on the Flame-Chase Journey, and I have not a single complaint. And yet... With Cifera... Her eyes, blue as the clearest lakes, could not mask her disappointment on the day we bid each other goodbye. There must be a reason, one she could not tell me...

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: That most beautiful melody once comforted my heart in the dark days. A millennium later, the feasts are long gone and the ocean stands masterless, with only the tides continuing to echo softly in my ears.

quotes.title: About Cerydra
quotes.text: A cruel tyrant, a fearless forerunner, a leader who brooked no opposition... The world has given her many labels, but the Flame-Chase would never have become what it is today without her.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: All that we experienced will become a thread in our lives. Thank you for embroidering the most beautiful patterns for Amphoreus's destiny.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: Amphoreus's "Time" has already received too many scars. Thankfully, that lively Nameless is now here. Like a dash of vibrant colors, she has swept away all the dusty gloom that the memories had built up.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
quotes.text: The golden threads can no longer detect doubts in his heart. From now on, he will certainly walk tall and proud on the road he chose.

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: When that one thread of "love" was woven into Amphoreus's destiny, her every gaze was already infused into the countless years, molding our lives into shape through our beating hearts.

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: Everyone is a means to take back the Coreflames in her eyes. That's right, "everyone" — including herself.

quotes.title: About Aglaea 2
quotes.text: I've never believed in vague divine prophecies, nor do I wish to be fettered by so-called duty. That has never changed. However, I respect her for holding onto her beliefs for a thousand years.

quotes.title: About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon
quotes.text: I keep wanting to explain to them how their divine prophecy is a self-fulfilling one. But now, seeing how they look no different from young children, I need not say anything more.

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: He is among my most exceptional students, yet this often implies that he and I... his teacher... will walk separate paths.

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: The battle against the black tide turned some people into gods, some into humans, and some into monsters — Mydei already made his choice when he took over Strife's authority.

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: Browsing books might be one of her ways to open her heart, but the answer she seeks can only be obtained through physical touch.

quotes.title: About Castorice 2
quotes.text: So what if she's a Titan? She's still a student of the Grove.

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: The divine tree can only grow towards the sky when it is supported by the sun. If the Twilight Courtyard is what protects the scholars of the Grove, then Hyacine is the "light" of the Twilight Courtyard.

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: How do you catch up to a tortoise that set off before you did? For Cipher, this paradox isn't hard to solve — she would happily scoop up the tortoise right at the starting line and toss it into her massive collection.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: To become a better god in the new world... You did it. And not only that, you also pushed everyone to become heroes together. That has far surpassed the definition of a god.

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: She recommended using honey brew to generate inspiration. Though intoxication can undoubtedly stimulate fantasies, fizzy horseradish vinegar still fits me better in terms of calmness and rationality.

quotes.title: About Cerydra
quotes.text: I heard that she always has thick tomes stacked up to the throne... I'd be happy to recommend some more books to her. After all, rather than wasting all that paper, it's better to see them being put to good use.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: Yet another pink-haired girl related to memories... Is this really just a coincidence?

quotes.title: About Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
quotes.text: Being able to read all of the Grove's books and interpret the mountains of information regarding Amphoreus in such a short time... He's more of an outstanding scholar than many people I know. And when it comes to knowledge about the dromas? He is indeed second to none.

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: The millions of memories she wrote should be enough to teach that false god this at the very least: It is not their right to answer the question of "What are we?"

quotes.title: About Saber
quotes.text: She's an old acquaintance of mine. The fact that you've summoned her as your Servant tells me you're a person of integrity. Don't doubt yourself, stay the course, and keep pushing ahead.

quotes.title: About Lancer
quotes.text: The Lancer class seems to attract its fair share of unfortunate Servants... Not every one of them, but there's one Heroic Spirit... His luck is so bad, it even affects the people who summon him.

quotes.title: About Aventurine
quotes.text: Masters and Servants tend to be alike in some way. For us, it's probably some obsession we can't seem to shake. But I wonder if he sees this as a blessing or a curse?

quotes.title: About Boothill
quotes.text: Seems to act on impulse, but there's a method to his madness... Hmph, guess he's the kind of person I can get along with.

quotes.title: About Pom-Pom
quotes.text: Who would've thought with such short limbs they could handle chores so efficiently? Appearances really are deceiving. Uhh, on second thought, I should say the conductor is just as perfect as they look. It's no wonder your journey's going so well.

quotes.title: About "Miss Note"
quotes.text: The mere fact that she's a Heroic Spirit proves her abilities and merit. She has no reason to underestimate herself.

quotes.title: About Skott
quotes.text: If every opponent he faced was like you, he'd probably turn out to be a decent person.

quotes.title: About Mr. Grady
quotes.text: Not many in this world seem to appreciate "film" the way he does. If they did, I'd have to be blunt, your world's taste in movies leaves a lot to be desired.

quotes.title: About Old Oti
quotes.text: People ought to act their age. If it's time to be six feet under, they shouldn't be out there causing chaos.

quotes.title: About Rin Tohsaka
quotes.text: Running into this walking disaster of a girl again... Honestly. I really thought she'd matured, but here she is, back in the thick of it. Fine... I can't exactly leave her to fend for herself now, can I?

quotes.title: About Gilgamesh
quotes.text: You're asking if I can defeat that King of Heroes who is so obsessed with his status as original? Hmph, that's a loaded question. Facing a guy like me, someone who'd throw away his pride without a second thought just to win, he'd never deign to use his full power.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: Miss March possesses a pure heart, and such purity is rare and precious — there are far too many people who are inherently vulgar, profit-driven, and adept at flattery. I wish to extend more compassion and esteem towards people like her.

quotes.title: About Himeko
quotes.text: This lady's spirit is admirably noble: Despite the challenges and hardships that Trailblazing entails, she has retained her poise and bravery — qualities that I profoundly admire. It is these qualities that I strive to embody and use against evil.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: While Mr. Dan Heng consistently maintains a sense of wariness towards others, his conduct remains unwaveringly honorable, and his expectations of himself are as stringent as the chivalric code. He possesses a unique form of beauty, I must say.

quotes.title: About Welt
quotes.text: Despite the things he has endured, Mr. Yang stays true to his heart and knows how to appreciate the small joys of everyday life. A man whose wisdom and maturity I find admirable.

quotes.title: About Pom-Pom
quotes.text: Such a fascinating ball of fluff. I imagine them to be exceptionally fitting perched atop a knight's shoulder, serving as a symbol of honor.

quotes.title: About Wubbaboo
quotes.text: Haha, such an adorable little creature.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: (Trailblazer)'s inherent qualities, are as beguiling and engaging now as they were on the day we first met.

quotes.title: About Asta
quotes.text: *sigh* ...I don't know why, but it seems like I manage to annoy Lady Asta fairly regularly.

quotes.title: About Herta
quotes.text: I'm different from the researchers — I'm not what you'd call a "follower" of Madam Herta — but she still lets me work here.

quotes.title: About The Herta
quotes.text: Madam Herta is a legend on the space station. Even I can tell you plenty of stories about her.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: There are many big heroes in this world, but very few friends who can stay by your side. I hope you'll never be as lonely as those other heroes.

quotes.title: About Sparxie
quotes.text: I tried to copy her and did a stream at the agency, but my stream ended up getting tags like "Trolling," "Pets," "Thrills," and "ASMR"... Maybe I should just admit that some people are born to be entertainers.

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: Some things can only be revealed by gnawing at them with teeth, instead of looking at them with eyes. That little green bird pecks at people, too, when she gets worked up, doesn't she?

quotes.title: About Kuchiba
quotes.text: I can't smell anything wrong with her... But that's what's suspicious about her, since most people involved in these Phantasmoon Games have a complex past.

quotes.title: About Boothill
quotes.text: He came to Planarcadia to look for his leader, only to return empty-handed. Everyone said that the previous leader of the Rangers took all the money and ran away to live the good life. Silly boy... Why won't he believe that?

quotes.title: About Rappa
quotes.text: That girl asked me to investigate Dr. Primitive's whereabouts and left Mister N with me. She said she'll come pick him up whenever we defeat Dr. Primitive for good. By then, I'll make sure to get her to pay for all the bananas.

quotes.title: About Evanescia
quotes.text: A student who keeps popping up at crime scenes...? That trope feels like it was ripped straight out of a mystery novel from the last Amber Era.

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf LV.999
quotes.text: Oho, now that's a cool name. Almost rivals my old handle, "Wolf King." We're both in the "hunting" business, but that relaxed vibe she has around her prey? That's something you just can't teach.

quotes.title: About Mortenax Blade
quotes.text: Just as a hunter never loses their sense of smell, a master craftsman is bound to make something masterful. Still... who would've thought I'd see a miracle like this in Planarcadia of all places.

quotes.title: About Himeko • Nova
quotes.text: Wait, let me get this straight. You're telling me some lady's been hauling a trainload of people across the cosmos, solving world-ending crises, and doing it all without her budget ever hitting rock bottom? And now she's gone and "leveled up" on top of it? Honestly... if she wasn't standing right here in front of me, I'd have pegged it as just another tall tale.

quotes.title: About Pearl
quotes.text: I—It's just payment for my job. A detective has to put his life on the line, you know? That's not called price gouging! Besides, haven't you noticed that she's mastered my hunting skills? Her eyes are getting sharper by the day.

quotes.title: About Arlan
quotes.text: Arlan's always saying stuff like, "all of you must heed Lead Researcher Asta's judgment!" Then when I remind him that that includes him, he says, "don't worry, I have my own judgment."

quotes.title: About Herta
quotes.text: If there's anyone who thinks they can be as headstrong as Madam Herta, I'd recommend they consider whether or not they possess her intelligence first.

quotes.title: About the Astral Express
quotes.text: I can't solve every problem the Express Crew might have in their voyage across the galaxy, but if money's ever the solution, come find me.

quotes.title: About Topaz
quotes.text: The last time I spoke with Topaz, we agreed to take a holiday. We were going to charter a ship, go star-seeing, and catch up on all the IPC gossip... but we still haven't had the chance...

quotes.title: About Ruan Mei
quotes.text: I asked Miss Ruan Mei where I could buy a charm like the one on her sleeve — but I was surprised to learn she'd hand-embroidered it. I was equally surprised when she gave me my own hand-embroidered charm the next time she came to the space station. Her craftsmanship, like her research papers, is superb.

quotes.title: About The Herta
quotes.text: I've only seen Madam Herta in the flesh a few times after the establishment of the Herta Space Station, but every one of those meetings was an unforgettable experience.

quotes.title: About Topaz
quotes.text: She's always searching for the optimal solution in maintaining equilibrium between the corporation and its customers. Not an easy feat if you ask me, but she's climbed the corporate ladder incredibly fast, so she must be doing something right.

quotes.title: About Dr. Ratio
quotes.text: The erudite folks of the Intelligentsia Guild are often eager to distance themselves from the IPC... and I suspect Ratio doesn't care for me much either. Unfortunately for him, I make for a more competent conversationalist than the other dimwits around here.

quotes.title: About Black Swan
quotes.text: Nothing remains hidden from a Memokeeper. If she's set her sights on you, it's clear she's after something. Consider how you might turn that to your advantage.

quotes.title: About Acheron
quotes.text: A chip of unknown value, a card of unknown suit, yet... it is she who will shape the entire course of the game.

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: Taking a shortcut or two isn't a big deal, but blatantly dipping your hands into someone else's pockets — that lacks finesse.

quotes.title: About Sparkle
quotes.text: The Fools never play to win — they're more like crazed thrill seekers.

quotes.title: About Jade
quotes.text: Be careful, our lady's kindness always comes with a price. I've received it many times, so I'm already used to it.

quotes.title: About Pearl
quotes.text: She's great at painting a scene, but doesn't like to make promises of future grandeur. Our ROI's sure to double a few times over if there are more colleagues like her in the IPC.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: Ever since I left Penacony, I've been hearing stories daily about the Nameless and their adventures in the cosmos. I'm glad we're no longer enemies, but the best of partners.

quotes.title: About Robin • Summeretto
quotes.text: All birds yearn to soar in the sky. Her song can penetrate false dreams. One day, she'll also be able to see through her own heart and compose a melody that belongs to her alone.

quotes.title: About Pearl
quotes.text: Planarcadia is just one of many worlds she plans to rebuild. Yet, she was willing to risk her life for it during a catastrophe. How many can truly live up to the phrase, "All for the Amber Lord"?

quotes.title: About Sugilite
quotes.text: I rarely meet people who are more passionate about being ostentatious than I am. He's one of them. In my eyes, reciprocity is only proper etiquette. Next time, it'll be his turn to play my game.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: The general comes to me with ailments such as "too tired to stay awake," and then he just asks how I've been and leaves after sitting around for a while. Sometimes he doesn't even take any medicine from me...

quotes.title: About Fu Xuan
quotes.text: Whenever Diviner Fu does overtime, we start running out of sugar powder for the medicinal eye-soothing tea...

quotes.title: About Yukong
quotes.text: Helm Master Yukong... She says she lets everything go everytime she sees me, but I don't think she has.

quotes.title: About Tingyun
quotes.text: Tingyun can endure more intense massages than other people, so I never show her mercy~

quotes.title: About Sushang
quotes.text: Ah, even if I don't step outside, I can still hear her. "Be eager to help those in need" — that's her, right?

quotes.title: About Qingque
quotes.text: I just wish I met the inventor of Celestial Jade earlier... This activity is great for both physical and mental health! It needs to get popularized!

quotes.title: About Guinaifen
quotes.text: Well... Um... Whenever I run off to play in Exalting Sanctum, I always bump into her and Sushang — they're usually in need of medical assistance... Sometimes Sushang is carrying her, sometimes she's carrying Sushang... and sometimes they're both in bad shape. How come? Performing arts can be dangerous, I guess.

quotes.title: About Hanya
quotes.text: I ran into her on a dark night once — she scared me half to death! Overworked, chronic insomnia, emotional turmoil — all the signs are there. If you ask me, she'd need to take it easy for a few decades to show any signs of recovery.

quotes.title: About Huohuo
quotes.text: She's always so jumpy and tense at her appointments, and I swear she talks to herself... o—or something we can't see. I should give her something stronger to calm her nerves.

quotes.title: About Xueyi
quotes.text: Wh—Why does it seem like she doesn't have to breathe? And her skin — why is it cold to the touch? It's like there's no blood running through her veins... Could she be... a ghost?

quotes.title: About Jiaoqiu
quotes.text: There are so many mysteries surrounding Dr. Jiaoqiu... How does he manage to eat so much spicy food without even breaking a sweat? Hey, maybe that's why he's always squinting his eyes — he eats too much spicy food!

quotes.title: About Lingsha
quotes.text: Cauldron Master Lingsha is very nice to me. She always takes me out to have fun~ But I heard some people whispering that she's not doing her duties... Bah! Going out with me to have fun is part of the Cauldron Master's duties!

quotes.title: About Feixiao
quotes.text: I really don't know how to treat her illness, so I can only ask her to eat tasty foods. If you eat well, your mood will improve, and if your mood is good, you can deal with a serious illness for longer, at least until a cure is found.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: Perhaps, there will come a day when you'll willingly share your memories with me — I eagerly await such a time.

quotes.title: About Acheron
quotes.text: Avoid entering someone's past memories lightly, especially hers.

quotes.title: About Aventurine
quotes.text: When exploring opportunities, one such as he, a gambler, will never reject your overtures. Gratify his whims, but also keep your defenses up.

quotes.title: About Sparkle
quotes.text: Hmm, a fascinating young girl. She won't admit it, but I imagine she's always yearned to be noticed by others. Her mind is the most chaotic place I've ever witnessed, but it also possesses the strongest tool of all — intuition.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: Even if her past is a forgotten whisper, and she was once bewildered about her future, March's experiences will undoubtedly transform into unique memoria. It's exciting to think just what memories she might bestow upon the Garden of Recollection...

quotes.title: About Misha
quotes.text: His being yet again demonstrates that... there are those who, despite being offered countless choices, will always choose the same path.

quotes.title: About Robin
quotes.text: Maybe it's because she left home early she realizes that dreams, while enchanting, are ultimately just that — dreams.

quotes.title: About Boothill
quotes.text: He cast aside his physical form in order to etch the memories of rage and sadness deeper into his being.

quotes.title: About Mr. Reca
quotes.text: He's a great partner, but everyone has their own aesthetics... How should I put it? Many things aren't about right or wrong. It's just a matter of them being difficult to coexist.

quotes.title: About Evernight
quotes.text: Memories are a silent and deep sea, and some people are the swaying little fish within. She, however, can block the very light in that water whenever she swims.

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: She treasured the fleeting moments, wove instants into eternity, and nurtured life in the graveyard of the Remembrance. Trust me when I say that such a scorching and loving gaze will remain forever new and forever bright in memories.

quotes.title: About The Dahlia
quotes.text: Her dangerous tendencies made a strong impression on me while we were working together at the Garden of Recollection. It's... not surprising that she became a Cremator. After all, her future is like the chaotic turbulences of fate... It never rests.

quotes.title: About Kafka
quotes.text: The mara's tether is firmly in her grasp. She will not pull upon it before the designated time, but nor shall she relinquish it.

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf
quotes.text: Within that world she calls a "game," she will never give up, nor yield to death.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: He always... He always understood the price better than any of us, yet he never spoke up — never did anything!

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: Imbibitor Lunae... When will our retribution come? How can our debt be repaid?

quotes.title: About Jingliu
quotes.text: As she brandished her sword, phantom pain surged through every part of my body... all because of her!

quotes.title: About Sam
quotes.text: I live in an eternal purgatory. And Sam — he is good at creating purgatory.

quotes.title: About Firefly
quotes.text: I yearn for the end, yet she yearns for survival... We are both destiny's slaves.

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf LV.999
quotes.text: She tried to convince me that games don't just end in "death." There are defeats and victories, too.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: I've always had a thing for those Xianzhou folks. This guy's a good one, and like me, he ain't much for talkin', preferring to express himself with his weapon. We're bound to hit it off!

quotes.title: About Acheron
quotes.text: I ain't got no idea what her story is, nor why she's parading around as a Galaxy Ranger... but that's alright. If a fella like me can uphold the justice, it means there ain't just one road to righteousness!

quotes.title: About Black Swan
quotes.text: Trackin' down this Memokeeper friend is only as tough as you make it for yourself. Wasting time sniffin' around for info is just like shootin' blanks. Better to just sit tight and meditate on "come find me" – who knows, she might just waltz on over.

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: What's that old saying again? Got it! The path to hell is paved with good intentions! That's the one!

quotes.title: About Argenti
quotes.text: Funny how fate works, we crossed paths before. Finding someone in this vast universe with such similar taste ain't easy y'know, both of us clad in silver, both packin' heat... And the cherry on top, we're both oozing with righteousness.

quotes.title: About Aventurine
quotes.text: Ha! That guy's as notorious as they come, just like me – a madman who throws caution to the wind. Maybe I should step it up, get him out of the way quicker... Haha, double my bounty in no time!

quotes.title: About Topaz
quotes.text: In that bunch of no-goods at the firm, she's considered one of the better ones, right? But as long as she's with the IPC, she's no different from the rest of 'em – all cut from the same cloth!

quotes.title: About Rappa
quotes.text: Don't be fooled by Rappa just because she's always jabberin' nonsense all day. Her chaotic little mind is sharper than a cactus needle! And, when it comes to right or wrong, Rappa strictly follows her own "way of the ninja" and is absolutely forkin' resolute about it.

quotes.title: About Mr. Reca
quotes.text: This guy is always obsessed with his beloved muddle-fudgin' films, and when he gets fixated on something, he ignores everything else... It's unfair to call him a bad person, but if you're not cautious around him, you might end up as "film material" for this here diggity fudge.

quotes.title: About Ashveil
quotes.text: You're talking about that dude who runs the detective agency? I heard he's got friends in both the government and the gangs and can find anyone he needs. But the only assignments he didn't take were mine... Feels like there's something fishy in it.

quotes.title: About Ashveil
quotes.text: You're talking 'bout that dude who runs the detective agency? I heard he's got friends in both the government and the gangs and can find anyone he needs. But the only assignments he didn't take were mine... Feels like there's something fishy in it... Ha! So you already know the truth? Well, guess I don't need to keep playin' dumb. Keepin' a secret's a real fudgin' son of a gun... But bein' in the boss's shoes? That's a whole nother kinda tough.

quotes.title: About Gepard
quotes.text: Captain Gepard...? I think he could accurately be described as Belobog's iron wall. In this city, it's more difficult to defend than go on the offensive.

quotes.title: About Serval
quotes.text: I remember I'd be there when mother and the rest of them would convene, and Serval would always patiently answer any questions I had... *sigh* I'm starting to feel like that was a long, long time ago.

quotes.title: About Pela
quotes.text: Whenever I praise her, she does her utmost to keep a straight face and hide any trace of happiness she might be feeling... I can tell, because I've practiced the same thing.

quotes.title: About Cocolia
quotes.text: I have deep respect for my mother, but she's no longer how I remember her. Perhaps I never realized who she truly was...

quotes.title: About Seele
quotes.text: Our first encounter may have been a bit of a disaster, but it was also the start of a new future... Haha, if Seele heard this she'd probably say I was giving one of my Overworld princess speeches.

quotes.title: About Lynx
quotes.text: The third child of the Landau family, right? I've heard Gepard mention her before, but I've yet to meet her. From what I've heard, "Lynxy" — as they call her — is very smart for her age.

quotes.title: About Topaz
quotes.text: I'm sure Jarilo-VI won't be the only planet to have IPC visitors, but I bet not all of them will have a visitor like Topaz...

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: When flowers bloom again, if we're lucky enough to meet in the new world, remember our promise.

quotes.title: About Polyxia
quotes.text: Now I know everything. My sister was unwilling to see the flowers wither, so she kept vigil over them, staying by them until they reached the end of their life. Now, I, too, will join her in accompanying the lost souls.

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: Only a sufficiently cold hand can grasp the burning Coreflame... Lady Aglaea must have come to terms with this long ago.

quotes.title: About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon
quotes.text: Everyone wishes to break free of their cocoon and fly toward the open sky as a butterfly, but they were the only ones who... chose to return to the cocoon, all for the sake of this world's rebirth.

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: Death brought by Strife is often full of pain and darkness, but what Lord Mydei grants to his enemies is a glorious and brilliant demise.

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: The more one has lost, the more adamant they are to regain everything... Perhaps that is why he will lead humanity till the very end.

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: He had once told me that I should stay calm even when facing the dead, and not tell them of my inner sorrows. It was only later that I understood "practicing how to die" was the theme that defined his entire life.

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: Even after witnessing so much life and death, she still sheds tears for those suffering from incurable ills... But she'll never let those tears into the patient's room. She wants to bring an ever-radiant sun to people's lives.

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: She has been a demigod for a long time. Her thoughts are mysterious, her whereabouts elusive... She often laments that the Flame-Chase Journey is a business that will eventually leave her with nothing. Yet there seems to be an unspoken sorrow hidden behind her words.

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: That beautiful knight... I've actually written a lot of poems about her based on what Tribbie told me. I always imagined her to be as pure as the ocean waves and as elegant as the tides... And it all turned out to be true once I met her.

quotes.title: About Cerydra
quotes.text: I still remember how the flower belonging to the Imperator was always different from everyone else's in the nether realm. Though small and frail, that blue blossom was always able to burst through the soil and bloom into a peerless flower, rivaled by none.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: I heard that Miss March also likes journaling and doing arts and crafts. Would she prefer plushies... or chimera pillows? If we get a chance to travel together, I bet we'll never feel lonely.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
quotes.text: I can tell that while Lord Dan Heng usually avoids expressing himself through words, he genuinely treasures every life he encounters... no matter how insignificant they may be.

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: If possible, I, too, would like to make a brilliant crystal flower for her as a gift... Never wilting, forever flawless, just like the "memories" she once gifted this world.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: Your moves on the board are always unexpected. Two parts whimsy, three parts imagination... and five parts unwavering courage.

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: I admire the way she speaks: not with sycophancy, nor with jest... In truth, it feels more like what you would call... friendship?

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: She came swimming, drawn by light and warmth, in pursuit of the ocean's Law. We seldom spoke at length. A single chessboard, a simple melody, and that was enough to understand each other's hearts.

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: Remarkable... Such a delicate golden thread, yet when stained with blood, becomes so razor-sharp. The holy city's fragile, teetering future needs exactly this kind of youth.

quotes.title: About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon
quotes.text: In chaotic times, many dismissed their prophecies, fooled by their childish looks... But wisdom knows no size, a truth that holds across all the seas.

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: My treasury has never needed guards, and her guarded heart has never loosened with age. It matters not. Let us quietly watch, and see what great thunderous waves this small kitten will raise in the future.

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: Though our statures differ greatly, we made the same choice as rulers... If we could face each other in a game of chess, I would surely regain that delightful feeling of finding an evenly-matched opponent.

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: I, too, once wandered in the icy-cold River of Souls. Her sea of flowers, though, is as beautiful and warm as a fire... It is thanks to her that the soldiers who were sacrificed could find rest, and our golden blood did not flow in vain.

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: Dux Sagax was so excited to write about "how to manage a dromas's fur" that he wrote me a ten-thousand-word essay. The most effective recommendation in there was to "mix redsoil with fish oil." Thanks to him, my noble mount will no longer shed its fur all over my dress.

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: I've said it at least a thousand times: Just because someone's short doesn't mean they're weak-willed and can be easily manipulated by fate. For those who still dare to refute that statement, Dux Lucens is even more proof.

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: With the weight of thirty million hollow shells and thirty million solitary warriors... he won against the gods and the ambitions of a monarch on the scales of destiny. This was not a miracle, but a glorious feat achieved with the power of the human will.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: It was all thanks to Dux Temporum's efforts that the final law I set up for Amphoreus was not triggered. Sometimes I have to admit that, while great deeds can be accomplished through wars soaked in blood and fire, it's love and tolerance that bring together hearts and minds.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
quotes.text: The gazes of countless lifeforms may be even greater than the expectations placed upon the crown. I look forward to seeing how far his trailblazing expedition will take him.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: Heeeeey, Gray Mystery~ Did it ever occur to you that we share the same sense of humor? And honestly, when it comes to picking up random stuff off the ground, we're basically two peas in a pod~

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: Those "actors" on the grand stage of history aren't adored just for their dazzling brilliance... What the audience truly anticipates is the moment of their fall.

quotes.title: About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon
quotes.text: Those old girls love me. Whenever I tried to slip away on a secret adventure, I'd discover my backpack already crammed with all sorts of food they snuck in there — it made leaping over the wall way harder!

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: What did they call him? "A dromas draped in finery"? And he took it just like that? Leaving aside the question of the nickname-giver's own credentials, Anaxa is undoubtedly an impressive individual...

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: The Deliverer boy looks naive, but he knows exactly what everyone wants and how much they're willing to pay... And yet everyone loves him because of the sincere way he talks. I concede my defeat.

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: When other people claim they can "defy death," I'd usually say they've knocked their head too hard. But that kid? He actually pulled it off — I've got to admit, that "Immortal Little Prince" is super awesome.

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: Isn't it just so much fun to tease her? I almost want that little Princess Homebody to lose it and scratch me, but no... she's way too nice for that. And weirdly, that just makes me angrier. I just hope she learns to take better care of herself.

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: That pink girl could easily leave those shriveled old goons behind, you know? If she didn't care, no one else would either. But no, she's too responsible for her own good, isn't she?

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: The dried fish she gave me was the best in all of Amphoreus. And somehow... it never ran out!

quotes.title: About Cerydra
quotes.text: "Even a humble pawn can check the enemy king"... I've forgotten everything else she said, but that one line stayed with me.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: So this is the famous "Rosy Celestial Maiden"? No wonder she looks so friendly. After all, I grew up listening to stories of her. But... hold on. Who's older than who again...?

quotes.title: About Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
quotes.text: I've seen him deep in thought, writing things down, but he noticed me as soon as I got close. He's pretty vigilant... Maybe he was also a wanderer once upon a time?

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: Countless memories, meticulous records... Wait. Does that mean she knows where my grand treasury is!? Although, I wouldn't really mind sharing half of it with her... No, I'll give her more than half. I can't stand people who don't treat themselves well!

quotes.title: About Natasha
quotes.text: Natasha said I'm also a doctor — for my robot friends.

quotes.title: About Seele
quotes.text: I remember one time Miss Seele saw me trying to pull a component out of a crack in the rocks. She smashed the rocks with one hand and walked away before I had time to say thank you...

quotes.title: About Svarog
quotes.text: Did you know Mr. Svarog's hands can turn into machines that dry my hair? Also, they can cut big stones and turn them into little tables and chairs...

quotes.title: About Hook
quotes.text: Hook invited me to join The Moles. I want to, but I think Mr. Svarog's too big to play hide and seek with us...

quotes.title: About Luka
quotes.text: Luka...? He's nice to people. I know he seems kinda impatient, but he's actually very caring.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer) 1
quotes.text: I'm gonna let you in on a secret... I was completely mesmerized by your gaze the first time we met! Hold still. Lemme see it again. Such pretty eyes... and the tomorrow reflected in them is equally beautiful, too ♪

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer) 2
quotes.text: I really look forward to seeing how (Trailblazer)'s "story" will unfold in future journeys. I hope Amphoreus's "memories" will become a romantic note in those journeys... It definitely will, right? ♪

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: That child running through the fields of Aedes Elysiae and laughing at the sun... That's still him, right? Fate will never catch up to him again.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: As fellow pink-haired girls, not only is our hair color the same, but we also like the same things! I really want to have a nice, long chat with March. We'd definitely create lots of brilliant memories together ♪

quotes.title: About Evernight
quotes.text: Beautiful flowers always have thorns, and as for feeling protective... I sometimes get consumed by that, too. But I know that she's a softie deep down. After all, she and March are flowers that bloomed from the same seed.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
quotes.text: (Trailblazer) always talks about Dan Heng. After all, having such a reliable companion to support the road ahead must be why the Trailblaze can dash forward so courageously.

quotes.title: About Terravox
quotes.text: His wish is about Amphoreus's creatures of the earth. What a precious yet fragile dream. That's why it must be nurtured diligently, isn't it?

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: Having a bespoke outfit made by Aglaea is the dream of everyone who wants to be beautiful, and that includes me! Attending a romantic banquet while dressed to the nines... Before I knew it, that dream had come true.

quotes.title: About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon
quotes.text: If all one thousand Tribbies were living in Okhema... then that'd surely be heaven! Hehe. I look forward to tomorrow even more every time I think about this.

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: Shh. I learned all my tricks for healthy living from him. Sleep early and rise early, eat lots and exercise lots... I've learned, um, the first half of both tenets!

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: I'm a big fan of Castorice's writings, too! Ahh... Did I say that too loud? You see... Apart from containing wonderful fantasies, her stories also really move me emotionally!

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: Hey, this way! I can do a "magic trick" too! Look closely, and don't blink... Ta-da! Here's a flower for you ♪

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: Drinking scented tea under a warm breeze, and petting soft and fluffy Little Ica with Hyacine... Hehe. Anyone would want to lose themselves in that fantasy, no?

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: Hey, do you want to hear some stories about what went down between Aglaea, Hysilens, and little Cipher? Listen closely now. You're the only person I'm gonna tell this to.

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: It's hard to forget Hysilens' songs after you've heard them. Thanks to her, every second of every day in this world is a magnificent gala. So let's dance together, shall we?

quotes.title: About Cerydra
quotes.text: The Imperator's crown really grabs your attention. Maybe... the next time we're in Aedes Elysiae, (Trailblazer) can also make a wreath of wheat for me ♪

quotes.title: About "Cyrene"
quotes.text: Flowers leave seeds behind, and these seeds bloom into new flowers. Every ripple of memory sparkles with the same shade. So, which "me" do you prefer? Heheh... You don't need to say it. That's just how "love" is, unfathomable, yet always the same ♪

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: March's weakness is that she likes to get involved in other people's business. ...Perhaps that's also her strength.

quotes.title: About Himeko
quotes.text: If you have questions about the Express, Himeko can give you the best answer.

quotes.title: About Welt
quotes.text: Mr. Yang is a very compassionate person, but thankfully he doesn't pry.

quotes.title: About Pom-Pom
quotes.text: My intuition tells me that it would be unwise to provoke the conductor.

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: Whether he can achieve his dream or not, being able to let go of everything and start again is already admirable enough.

quotes.title: About Mortenax Blade
quotes.text: "Cloud-Piercer" once shattered, yet it grew sharper after being reforged. A blade reflects the hand that forged it... that much is true.

quotes.title: About Himeko • Nova
quotes.text: Himeko once told me that we should embrace the past and look toward the future. After seeing her interpretation of those words, they carry a whole new weight to them now.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: Sometimes the general treats me as a friend from the old days. Unfortunately, I am unable to return the sentiment.

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: The high elder succession was incomplete, causing her to become trapped in shallow waters... Fortunately, she has a vitality that does not bend to the will of others.

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: That young swordmaster has a keen eye and a swift hand, but I have no desire to compete with anyone in a sword fight.

quotes.title: About Blade
quotes.text: What he seeks I am unable to provide.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: Fearless, optimistic, confident... I learn so much every time I trailblaze with you.

quotes.title: About March 7th: Evernight
quotes.text: Be it Evernight, or the two of us, (Trailblazer), we'll become memories of March 7th's past... yet walk beside her as she moves forward.

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: The future spun from golden thread was nothing more than a dream, but her sincere and unwavering heart led others to bring it to life.

quotes.title: About Tribbie
quotes.text: "Those who are truly great never lose their childlike innocence." I'm reminded of this old Xianzhou saying whenever I see them.

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: As king, he personally shaped the transformation of the Kremnoan Dynasty. His power to reform left a deeper mark than Strife ever could.

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: Her thousand-year journey proved once again that living with a clear conscience means more than a long lifespan.

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: His style is completely different from that of ordinary teachers... If we had the chance to spend more time together, I'm sure we'd have plenty to talk about.

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: That sky where twilight converges has already brought glimmers of hope to life in Amphoreus.

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: Everyone might be running away from something, but in the end, we all eventually head towards what we truly desire.

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: When I grasped the Coreflame, the conflagration of more than thirty million recurrences felt real for the first time. His endurance and defiance deserve the highest respect from the Nameless.

quotes.title: About Terravox
quotes.text: Heavier than the Coreflame of Earth are the hopeful gazes of every living being in Amphoreus. His journey reached its end. Now it's time for us to carry that hope forward.

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: As a fellow kin of water, I am always reminded of Scalegorge Waterscape's tides when she sings... I hope the people of Amphoreus may one day find a sea just as clear and pure.

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: It is thanks to her that the ages were carved into an epic, preserved, not scattered to the wind. In the future, these memories will surely grant the Chrysos Heirs the courage to keep moving forward.

quotes.title: About Herta
quotes.text: Herta is a quintessential genius — a natural wonder who sees no one as her equal. I have no doubt that she is talented, but I doubt whether her talent is always helpful to others.

quotes.title: About Screwllum
quotes.text: In his field, Screwllum is trying to establish new laws. I prefer to call such a person a monarch, rather than a genius.

quotes.title: About Ruan Mei
quotes.text: How many people have been fooled by her claim to fame as a hermetic genius? It seems to me that she wants to explore much more than just life. Just wait and see — the Genius Society member with all the real ambition is her.

quotes.title: About Aventurine
quotes.text: Our man here always manages to wriggle out from the jaws of catastrophe, and we can't chalk it all up to "good luck." The audience is forever anticipating his blunder... maybe he's anticipating it as well — will that day ever come?

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: Fools think themselves wise, but the wise know their own ignorance — now, he has become the latter.

quotes.title: About Aventurine • Waveflair
quotes.text: A gambler losing everything again? That's hardly surprising. What is surprising is that he chose to win this round alongside all of you. It seems he's finally learned to stop punishing himself... and start making some real "friends."

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: Being able to respond to the kind-hearted hopes among all the malicious wishes, and become a hero protecting Elation in Planarcadia... Only our Baseball Raccoon could do it.

quotes.title: About Sparxie
quotes.text: She said I'd be the perfect fit for promoting headphones on stream. If I did a livestream, it would take Planarcadia by storm for sure... What a shame. If I weren't so pressed for time, I'd definitely want to give it a shot.

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: I really want to go play claw machines, scratch lottery tickets, and pull for characters with her... I'm not just saying things! Even if you don't believe in Aha, you have to believe in Yao Guang's luck!

quotes.title: About Ashveil
quotes.text: On the surface, a washed-up detective with nothing to his name. Underneath, a renowned Ranger hero... Sounds straight out of a comic book, right? Planarcadia is exactly the kind of place where the unexpected is always possible.

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf LV.999
quotes.text: I can't believe she's a die-hard fan of Planarcadia's first video game! You know that feeling of pure joy when you finally meet someone who just gets it? When it comes to gaming, I will always pledge my allegiance to Lady Silver Wolf!

quotes.title: About Mortenax Blade
quotes.text: Sealing the undying Abundance within his own body... I have to admit, that's a rather novel approach.

quotes.title: About Himeko • Nova
quotes.text: Fate truly works in mysterious ways. Back then, she was just a girl gazing at the stars, beginning her own little Fluffy Across the Blue. Now, she's returned like a hero straight out of a comic to save her home. I suppose it's true after all, nothing gets my heart racing quite like the triumph of the human spirit!

quotes.title: About Pearl
quotes.text: Let me recall... Not many past CEOs of Planarcadia were as humble as her! Once, I even critiqued her artwork while passing by. Heh, I admit that I'm quite the bold critic, but she was truly open to feedback. She surprised me entirely!

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: What would happen if the power of the Stellaron were to be unleashed...? Would you return to the "past"? Or would you reclaim your "memories"? Curious indeed.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: The days spent traveling with you all have already left an indelible mark on him.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: The best future for her would be when I can completely disappear.

quotes.title: About Cyrene 1
quotes.text: Remember this eternal truth: Girls with pink hair are never to be underestimated.

quotes.title: About Black Swan
quotes.text: I can count on one hand the number of Memokeepers who've kept their cool in front of me. Could it be that... she's seen something even more terrifying?

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: Such a talented tailor should have woven more memories for Amphoreus. If it were me, I would certainly feel regret for not being able to witness Amphoreus's future with my own eyes.

quotes.title: About Tribbie
quotes.text: "See you tomorrow," such a simple yet luxurious wish for anyone.

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: Whether as a crown prince or as a warrior, he carries too many memories of hatred. Yet when fulfilling his duties, he never confuses the past with the future.

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: Would the sea of flowers she planted survive a baptism from the Rain of Sensation?

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: I've always wanted to ask him this question: "If a dromas and the truth of the world both fell into the sea, which one would you save first?"

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: Sunny weather is irritating, but I must admit, the light she casts is soft and comfortable even for me.

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: A beautiful lie is indeed better than a thousand cruel truths.

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: He sets out from a blank starting point in every recurrence, yet always ends up at the same finale. Will mine and March 7th's fate be any different?

quotes.title: About Cerydra
quotes.text: Being able to take down that "genius" just shows you can't underestimate people who are good at games of wit... If I ever get the chance, I'd love to test my wits against her.

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: She's like a beautiful bubble. Even when it bursts, it resonates like a trembling note on a string, moving hearts all the same.

quotes.title: About Welt
quotes.text: I can see it. The heroic fire from the past still burns in his heart. Having such an experienced senior to guide the way makes me feel much more at ease.

quotes.title: About Himeko
quotes.text: Mature, elegant, fragrant like a rose... March has been working hard to learn from her. As the Express ventures into deeper starry skies, how will Himeko bloom in the future?

quotes.title: About Pom-Pom
quotes.text: I really want to pet them. But alas, this mysterious "Conductor" doesn't look like they'd take kindly to it.

quotes.title: About Terravox
quotes.text: What makes life eternal? Memories? No, memory can only preserve a decaying past. Yet they willingly became the cornerstone for the future, leaving behind a legacy that will endure for generations.

quotes.title: About Cyrene 2
quotes.text: I hope this unexpected "rain" I bring can make this barren time bloom... into the hundreds of flowers she once dreamed of ♭

quotes.title: About Huaiyan
quotes.text: Despite all the hardships elder Huaiyan has faced, he still finds joy in the world. He is an example every general should follow.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: "The Merlin's Claw vs. The Seiche Queller"... Many in the Alliance enjoy this kind of spectacle, and truthfully, so do I. When it comes to strategic brilliance and decisive outcomes, I wonder who would win, Jing Yuan or Yao Guang?

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: What an amazing kid! Way more gifted than I was. If I were to mentor him, I'd surely turn him into a legendary warrior general! Unfortunately, his master doesn't follow this path... but I suppose having both wisdom and bravery is even more commendable.

quotes.title: About Yunli
quotes.text: Old master Huaiyan is so shrewd, yet the child he brought up is so forthright... It's a shame I can't devote myself entirely to mentoring a disciple, and I probably won't ever get it in this lifetime.

quotes.title: About Moze
quotes.text: I granted him permission to "assassinate" me anytime he wished. Lately, his attempts have become less frequent, but his accuracy has improved significantly. Good effort, but patience is key — the time for the perfect strike has yet to come.

quotes.title: About Jiaoqiu
quotes.text: Doc Jiao always complains that his face looks untrustworthy and people think he has too many crafty ideas. But when push comes to shove, you can absolutely depend on those ideas.

quotes.title: About Jiaoqiu 2
quotes.text: An eye for an eye, and a hundred times more.

quotes.title: About Lingsha
quotes.text: The most important skill for sorting out a mess is being tough and ruthless. Don't be deceived by her ethereal appearance... she has what it takes to put the Luofu's Alchemy Commission back in order.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: That girl had some martial training already, so it makes sense she'd come to the Xianzhou to learn swordsmanship. She sure is dashing! But she lacks bravery... What's wrong with my axe? Not good enough for her?

quotes.title: About Yukong
quotes.text: Even after all this time, being by her side makes me feel like a young fox again... Perhaps it's because she's become more affectionate with age?

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: She's an expert at guarding the Formation Core and reading fortunes. Unfortunately, she dislikes physical training, which leaves her with frequent headaches. So I always tell her: Even the mind's work calls for a body that is strong.

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf
quotes.text: She always complains that I don't have any strategy when I play games — that I just go "clank-clank-clank, bang bang!" and it's over. But I can't learn that trick of hers, what's it called again... cheesing? Am I just too stupid?

quotes.title: About Kafka
quotes.text: She willingly approaches me, and when I try to approach her, I get the feeling that the distance between us is getting bigger and bigger... Kafka told me: "When making friends with someone, keep the right distance, in order to maintain a long-lasting relationship." But I don't think she actually believes this.

quotes.title: About Blade
quotes.text: He seeks an ending through "death" while I seek an opportunity for "life." Though we walk on opposite paths, we will reach the same destination, and he... will not become destiny's slave.

quotes.title: About Acheron
quotes.text: I can see... she once walked in the rain, once burned in battle, and once held the cold ashes in her hands — in a way completely different from mine.

quotes.title: About Black Swan
quotes.text: Even if life is short, memories can be eternal. As long as Black Swan still remembers me, the mark I leave on this world will not disappear.

quotes.title: About Gallagher
quotes.text: Learning about everything he experienced is like reading a brilliant novel. You know that the people are made up, but you still can't help but feel joy and sadness for them. Maybe by the end, we'll have long-lost track of who the author, the reader, and the characters are.

quotes.title: About Robin
quotes.text: Her gorgeous attire, her exquisite voice, her gentle demeanor... They all cause many people to underestimate her. But compared to her glittering appearance, her bravery and purity leave an even deeper impression.

quotes.title: About Jade
quotes.text: Jade stone can be pawned off, but not everything can be used in an exchange. Outside of life itself, there are more valuable things that I don't want to give up.

quotes.title: About The Dahlia
quotes.text: Miss Constance had a gentle and sympathetic look in her eyes when she heard my story, but she never mentioned her own past... What did she have to pay every time she betrayed fate?

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf LV.999
quotes.text: They call that... "stomping," right? But she also said that in a game, having "fun" is just as important as being "OP"... So I can't help but worry: Walking the Path of Finality, what price will she have to pay for it?

quotes.title: About Mortenax Blade
quotes.text: Death is unbearably painful... let alone thousands of times over. No one wishes for their own death. What he seeks is release... and perhaps, that is something only he can grant himself.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: Hmph, as it stands, Jing Yuan has promised to nominate me to the generalship on 122 separate occasions. For 121 of them, I made my case and he replied with a nonchalant "mm-hmm." The one other time, I spoke at length on my reasoning and watched him gradually fall asleep...

quotes.title: About Qingque
quotes.text: The Divination Commission is full of idlers, but she is the only one who has truly mastered the art of slacking off — and getting away with it... She could write a whole book on the subject! Sometimes I even wonder if she could escape my divination...

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: For a long time, I thought that the tea the Dragon Lady made for me had a secret ingredient for replenishing the weary. Eventually, I discovered that the secret ingredient was just extra sugar. Such a subtle method for treating fatigue, but I expect nothing less from such an exceptional member of the Alchemy Commission!

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: Whenever I get into a heated discussion with Jing Yuan and allow my tone to betray me, Yanqing starts glaring at me. Still, I don't need the omniscia to know that the odds of that child making a move against me are minimal...

quotes.title: About Tingyun
quotes.text: The various merchant guilds under the Sky-Faring Commission each have their own strengths. I've heard that Tingyun's Whistling Flames is adept at producing value by sifting through piles of ordinary items. Such is the way of divination: seeing potential possibilities in everything.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: The shadows of future possibilities and the direction of one's path should normally be readily apparent... I can't detect any traces of these on you. Strange...

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: Destiny usually flows before us into the future, but for her, it flows into the past... As far as she is concerned, is the past a force for good or bad?

quotes.title: About Huohuo
quotes.text: That girl may be shy, but she's been lauded by many... If I had that kind of assistance, it would take a load off my mind...

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: I recall my days as a student... I argued with my senior soror on every matter. She would always concede, and I mistook it for proof that my studies surpassed hers. Looking back now, I see how childish I was. Hmph. When it comes to the pursuit of knowledge, what place is there for concession?

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: The general's skill in maximizing returns with minimal effort is still vivid in my mind... I hope that one day, I can witness it again.

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: I remember... I once gave him some rare toys. He was a very polite child, and when he came across a sword he liked, he became absolutely radiant with delight.

quotes.title: About Yukong 1
quotes.text: I still remember... Whether it was driving starskiffs or leading the Sky-Faring Commission, Madam Yukong was always present in the Xianzhou's course.

quotes.title: About Yukong 2
quotes.text: Madam Yukong told me, there was a day when she too once "died," and in the long days that have followed, she's been searching for that feeling of being "alive" again.

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: I'm not sure why, but lately, I've been feeling especially tired. I keep thinking about Lady Bailu. Next time I'm back on the Luofu, I'll definitely go visit her.

quotes.title: About Qingque
quotes.text: Is she a diviner of the Divination Commission... or the proprietress of the games parlor?

quotes.title: About Fu Xuan
quotes.text: I could never forget the master diviner's stern yet pleasant voice... Though she spares no feelings, every word she says makes sense.

quotes.title: About Ruan Mei
quotes.text: "Resurrection" is always a strange experience, but Miss Ruan Mei instructed me to not overthink things. I just needed to follow a regular routine and focus on exercise to regain my health. Her tone was so relaxed... as if this was all a simple task.

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: I'd always heard Madam Yao was as sharp as they come, and also easy to get along with. Since she took charge, the Xianzhou's been much more open with outsiders, merchants even say she's the Fortune Star reborn.

quotes.title: About the Nameless
quotes.text: Back when the stars were still connected, this world too saw the footprints of Nameless wanderers. Sadly, Penacony never managed to remember any of their names.

quotes.title: About Misha
quotes.text: Misha is a sensible kid. Me? At his age I was just a little terror, biting everyone in sight.

quotes.title: About Misha 2
quotes.text: When I met Mikhail he was already grown up... but whatever the case, Misha's still here. He's spent his whole life with me, and for that, I should be glad.

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: He reminds me of the "Odes of Harmony," but I caught a whiff of something behind the facade he puts on... something real.

quotes.title: About Robin
quotes.text: We've seen many outsiders come to Penacony, but locals leaving? That's rare... She must have had her reasons.

quotes.title: About Bronya
quotes.text: Lady Bronya has ventured deep into the most dangerous regions of the front line with us — many times for that matter.

quotes.title: About Serval
quotes.text: Many people seem to like talking about how my sister changed since she left the Guards, but in reality... she's exactly the same person.

quotes.title: About Pela
quotes.text: I heard my sister started asking Pela to look after my flowers when I'm away... I hope it's not too much trouble for her.

quotes.title: About Cocolia
quotes.text: I've always firmly believed that no one knows this city better or loves it more than the supreme guardian.

quotes.title: About Sampo
quotes.text: He's very... cunning. According to leads provided by citizens, he's got his hands on a number of ancient relics. He sold off most of them, but it seems he's using others to commit various frauds.

quotes.title: About Lynx
quotes.text: My little sister has a... peculiar streak. No, no, I don't mean a bad temper... *sigh* Let's just say she reminds me more of Serval than me.

quotes.title: About Saber
quotes.text: To a King, a nation is nothing more than a possession. If you cannot dominate it, you might as well cast aside the crown. That is why she was consumed by her own nation.

quotes.title: About Lancer
quotes.text: He's got brawn and brains in spades. But for all his skill with that lance, he's not quite ready to be called a king.

quotes.title: About Archer
quotes.text: A "champion of justice"? A world where no one gets hurt? He says such ridiculous things. The pretense of equality is nothing more than drivel by the weak who cannot face darkness. His ideal is just an excuse to cover up ugliness.

quotes.title: About Rin Tohsaka
quotes.text: Once you've chosen the path of the arcane, you can only march toward something beyond human — but perhaps that girl, an Average One, can truly Trailblaze a path never seen before.

quotes.title: About Ishtar
quotes.text: Donning that girl's face seems to have made that useless goddess look a good deal brighter. Although I shall never forgive the transgressions of her past... Hmph. It is a fortunate turn of events that she has learned a modicum of discipline within the confines of a mortal vessel.

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: A true hero is one who shoulders all they behold, without exception. I had thought myself the only existence capable of enduring the collective weight of this world, to think this cosmos held another capable of such a feat. However, a flaw remains. He is far too humble! If one possesses the strength to bear the world, he need not call himself a Deliverer. He must claim the title of king!

quotes.title: About Ashveil
quotes.text: So, the participant paired against me is that "broken-legged wolf"? Hardly a surprise. If you are looking for someone whose losses could rival my own, you will find no other in this Holy Grail War.

quotes.title: About Herta and Dr. Ratio
quotes.text: In that vast universe, those who share my refined tastes are few and far between. For the most part, humans are nothing more than beasts devoid of self-awareness. Since you have found your resolve, the next step is slaying gods. I look forward to that day with great anticipation.

quotes.title: About Kuchiba
quotes.text: That security officer is far from the simple-looking girl she appears to be. Quiet as she may seem, once she is moved to action, she becomes a merciless, unrestrained beast of pure performance... Hmph. Why must I always be surrounded by such eccentricities?

quotes.title: About Sushang
quotes.text: Shangshang is my best friend. Aside from my street-performing brothers, she's the person I've known the longest on the Luofu. I wanted to become sworn sisters with her, but she didn't seem interested.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: I heard that the general is interested in these street music performances. I wish I had the chance to perform at the Seat of Divine Foresight, then I could be famous.

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: I've never spoken to the general, but I did meet his retainer once. He asked me if I was a "woman of the sword," so you know what I did? I did a sword-swallowing performance right in front of him!

quotes.title: About Qingque
quotes.text: Qingque likes to play celestial jade in Exalting Sanctum, but sometimes she gets tired and comes to see me juggling. I can tell from her face if she's won or lost that day — red is a win, pale is a loss, and really pale means her boss is out looking for her.

quotes.title: About Huohuo
quotes.text: Isn't Huohuo's laugh just the cutest? My performances aren't scary — they're uplifting! I can't wait to see her laugh some more~

quotes.title: About Jiaoqiu
quotes.text: That healer seems to be a senior colleague of Sushang's... But I heard that he's even more energetic than she is! Maybe everyone from the Yaoqing is that way?

quotes.title: About Xueyi
quotes.text: Have you ever been to The Shackling Prison? The whole place is pitch black, except for the light cast by the occasional spiritfarer's lamp. To me, this mortal world is the prison, and my sister is the lamp.

quotes.title: About Huohuo
quotes.text: The judges of the Ten-Lords Commission are all people who suffer from some affliction or another, and this child is no exception. She might be timid, but she is very capable at work. It would be unwise to underestimate her.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: The general has experienced many hardships, any one of which would be enough to break the spirit of an ordinary Xianzhou citizen... but he seems to handle it all with grace. He must have his own way of coping.

quotes.title: About Blade
quotes.text: This man has violated every statute in the Xianzhou Legal Code. It is rare to find a long-life individual who carries such a crime-ridden history and still maintains his sanity... Once my sister catches him, I'll examine his crimes in detail.

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: The ability of the Vidyadhara to cast their memories and past sins to the Lunarescent Depths before reincarnating is truly enviable. But the Dragon Lady seems to be different from other Vidyadhara... She carries a heavy burden that has been passed down since long, long ago, and getting just a glimpse of it can be suffocating.

quotes.title: About Yukong
quotes.text: The Foxian lifespan is only 300 years, but that is better than the Xianzhou natives who spend nearly a thousand years bumbling around... When one has forgotten the concept of death, life also becomes meaningless. Such is the curse placed by the Plagues Author.

quotes.title: About Luocha
quotes.text: Why does someone carry a coffin around? Is it to remind yourself of constantly being chased by death? This is similar to the judges of the Ten-Lords Commission — we enter the land of the dead to bring the dignity of life to the Xianzhou people.

quotes.title: About Tail
quotes.text: The technique for sealing a heliobus inside Huohuo's tail, though seldom seen on the Luofu, is not so uncommon on other Xianzhou ships... though I really shouldn't divulge too many details.

quotes.title: About Arlan
quotes.text: Asta provided financial assistance to a few exceptional children — I assume Arlan was one of them.

quotes.title: About Asta
quotes.text: If my other collections had people like Asta watching over them, I could take a hands-off approach.

quotes.title: About Himeko
quotes.text: I give her the most boring things, and then she gives them back to me and they're suddenly interesting.

quotes.title: About Ruan Mei
quotes.text: Ruan Mei is a genius among geniuses — I won't deny that. I don't always get along with her, but I do admire her... Maybe the admiration is mutual.

quotes.title: About The Herta
quotes.text: Special condition detected. Remote puppet automatic praise mode — on. Madam Herta is a peerless gem. Madam Herta is an unrivaled genius. Madam Herta is an inimitable beauty...

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: If I woke up on the Express without any memories, there's no way I'd recover as quickly as March has. I admire her for that, but I also worry about her... If I'm ever too busy, please do take the time to chat with her.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: Dan Heng is the cautious type — I think he's gotten used to doing things by himself. He doesn't like to bother or inconvenience others. That's why I asked him to be the train's guard and maintain the data bank. I don't think he'd have joined us if there wasn't anything for him to do.

quotes.title: About Welt
quotes.text: I think Welt's anxious that he can't keep up with you youngsters, but he sure seems young at heart to me...

quotes.title: About Pom-Pom
quotes.text: To Pom-Pom, I'll always be the train's mechanic, haha.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng 2
quotes.text: He's not so uptight nowadays. I think (Trailblazer) and March helped him understand that relying on others sometimes really isn't a big deal.

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: The Express has welcomed countless passengers with different personalities. They all have their own destinations and purposes, but this doesn't stop them from sharing a wonderful journey with the Express. I hope he can also reach his desired destination.

quotes.title: About The Herta
quotes.text: I wander among the stars, and she swims in the sea of knowledge. Our journeys do not intersect much, but we are both trailblazing the boundaries of the unknown.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng 3
quotes.text: I believe that he will eventually overcome the obstacle named "the past." The stars are infinite, and countless possibilities await him in the future.

quotes.title: About March 7th 2
quotes.text: March has a sort of miraculous power. Wherever she goes, all things dark and gloomy will be covered by her bright, lively, and unique color. I believe that her "past" will also eventually become a part of her, walking with her towards her future.

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: This general... she has quite a style. She's almost more like someone hailing from an Elation-blessed world than I am. I know she has her own plans, but since the Xianzhou is our ally now, feel free to let me know of any concerns you may have.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: Truth be told, from the moment I first saw you, I picked up on this sharp, slightly playful sense of humor... Maybe that's just my Planarcadia intuition talking.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: I used to worry that as the weight of our journey grew, I'd eventually stop seeing March's signature smile. Looking at her now, she's certainly matured, but that spark of innocence that makes her who she is? That's never faded for a second.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: Enjoying the Trailblaze is just as important as the destination, and I'm glad he's finally starting to get that. I suspect Dan Heng will only get better at his "Xianzhou's Number One Assassin" routine from here on out.

quotes.title: About Welt
quotes.text: Welt's passion for the Starblazer still caught me by surprise... He's been working on his Starblazer comic every single day lately. Honestly, if I'd known he'd be this obsessed, I should've let him stay in the pilot's seat a little longer.

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: Though wearing the Supplicant's mask came about by accident, those constant twists of fate have instead brought his potential to "Trailblaze" the unknown into full view.

quotes.title: About Pom-Pom
quotes.text: If Pom-Pom knew I'd asked you to look after them, I can already hear the grumpy correction: "Who's looking after who here!?" But between us... I know Pom-Pom secretly loves every second of it.

quotes.title: About Ryusuke
quotes.text: Most of my memories before the age of six are a blur now... just fragments of a dream. A rattling toy, moonlight catching a strand of crimson hair, a dab of paint someone snuck onto my nose... but the moment I open my eyes, they're gone.

quotes.title: About Asat Pramad
quotes.text: What lies at the end of the Trailblaze? He showed us one of the darkest possible answers with his own life. No matter how far our journey takes us, please, keep the oath of the Nameless etched forever in your hearts.

quotes.title: About Motoko
quotes.text: Once upon a time, we'd weave through the bustling crowds together, sit by the banks of the Dovebrook just watching the water flow, or hide away in our "secret base" trying to figure out how to fix those broken parts... Motoko never really left. In the quiet of a thousand lonely nights, I can still feel her gaze, steady and watching over me, as I fulfill the promise we made at the very start.

quotes.title: About Evanescia
quotes.text: We crossed paths once, during the last season of the Phantasmoon Games. Carrying the weight of an entire world on her shoulders while looking that effortless... Honestly, I could learn a thing or two from that kind of grace under pressure.

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: Maybe one day, she'll just appear out of nowhere and give us one of those graceful smiles. After all, finding a glimmer of hope in the middle of the impossible? That's always been her specialty.

quotes.title: About Sparxie
quotes.text: Looking back, the show Sparxie put on was actually the kindest performance in the entire Phantasmoon Games. If all the Fools had her sense of restraint, maybe thrilling comedies would be the rule rather than the exception.

quotes.title: About Ashveil
quotes.text: As a navigator, I can relate to how difficult it is to lead a team forward. Instead of trying to shoulder everything alone, learning to lean on your companions... well, it makes the journey a lot easier to bear.

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf LV.999
quotes.text: In the Phantasmoon Games fifteen years ago, I briefly stood at the very peak of "Elation" myself. To keep a cool head in the face of that kind of temptation... her understanding of the "Game" has far exceeded my expectations.

quotes.title: About Pearl
quotes.text: When it comes to defending Planarcadia, her impeccable planning left a lasting impression on me. But I still find that she's the most gentle and moving color on this canvas of Elation.

quotes.title: About Natasha
quotes.text: Old witch... Ahem. Natasha is beautiful and nice, but when she gets angry she, uhh... isn't so nice. B—But still beautiful...

quotes.title: About Clara
quotes.text: Waaaah... Clara... when can you join The Moles...?

quotes.title: About Svarog
quotes.text: Hook's Diggertron is mightier than Svarog's fist! Hmph!

quotes.title: About Sampo
quotes.text: I run into Mr. Sampo almost everywhere. Does he like expeditions too?

quotes.title: About Seele
