quotes.text: Miss Seele talks loud, but sometimes Hook still beats her in an argument, hehe~

quotes.title: About Fersman
quotes.text: Hook loves daddy! One day, Hook's gonna dig up a big treasure and build daddy a huge huge house!

quotes.title: About Luka
quotes.text: Luka loves to eat meat — just like Hook! That's why we're such great friends!

quotes.title: About Guinaifen
quotes.text: Little Gui? She has a lot of yang energy — she dispels bad luck very easily. Even my tail goes quiet when she's around. The only drawback is I have to raise my voice around her if I wanted to be heard...

quotes.title: About Xueyi
quotes.text:
Huohuo: The puppet judge? She really scared me at first... but when Tail threatened her, she didn't bat an eyelid. Madam Xueyi is amazing — I really want to be like her one day...
Tail: Amazing!? Let's see if she still has that smirk on her face when I burn the Ten-Lords Commission to the ground!

quotes.title: About Hanya
quotes.text: In order to differentiate between the sisters, I call her the rambling judge... *gasp* She hasn't found out, has she?

quotes.title: About Qingque
quotes.text: It seems like Qingque is always on a break. When I'm relaxing, she's relaxing, and when I get swamped with work, guess what...? She's still relaxing! I guess the Divination Commission has a pretty light workload...

quotes.title: About Tail
quotes.text:
Huohuo: B—Be more determined? I usually just want to run away... Still, every time I try, Mr. Tail sends me straight back to the enemies' doorstep. *sigh* Why can't he just leave me be...?
Tail: Hmph! Fine by me! If you get swallowed whole, I'll finally be able to break free!

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: People say that the general's portrait can be used to dispel evil. I tried but... useless... I—I mean the portrait, not the general. I shouldn't have believed in such superstitious nonsense.

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: I wonder if the Dragon Lady has any "brave pills" for sale... If not, "play dead pills" might do the trick...

quotes.title: About Yukong
quotes.text: How come Madam Yukong has an air of authority, but I don't? I mean, we're both Foxians. Actually... I know why, but I can't help being a little envious.

quotes.title: About Sushang
quotes.text: Actually, we met a long time ago. I was outside getting some peace and quiet, when all of a sudden she dragged me before the Realm-Keeping Commission Chancery. She mistook me for a missing person...

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: Apparently Grayie had lots of amazing adventures in the lands beyond the sky. I'd love to go with them to the worlds beyond if I can. After all, I'm a denizen of the sky!

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: It's rare to see someone as emotionally stable as Dannie. It's as if he doesn't react even when faced with the darkest of calamities. He'd make a good healer.

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: Someone once complained to me that Lady Aglaea is always so unreadable and untrustworthy... But I sensed a faint warmth still beating under her icy-cold skin when I took her hands. I believe she simply used her words to conceal her true intentions.

quotes.title: About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon
quotes.text: Lady Tribbie once invited me to board their rocket. It wasn't a long journey, but it was really exciting to fly through the Marmoreal Palace... They told me I wouldn't be scared as long as I kept looking straight ahead.

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: Cassie really likes my little garden. She keeps circling the courtyard from far away, going round and round, forgetting to even blink. It'll take something even cuter for her to snap out of that state... Maybe a chimera?

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: Professor Anaxa refuses to outline key topics for exams, and insists on one-on-one oral tests! Students inevitably end up in my care every exam season due to mental exhaustion...

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: Lord Phainon is kind and friendly to all his companions, but there's always a sliver of pain in his smile... He must have lost something very dear to him.

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: Lord Mydei's regenerative abilities are way faster than that of an ordinary human. Even when he's badly wounded and requires my help, he still talks and jokes as if nothing's wrong... Strange... now that I think about it, he seems way chattier than usual during those moments.

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: You can probably figure out Lady Cipher's mood just by looking at her tail~ If the tail's standing up, then she's happy. If only the tip is moving, that means she doesn't want to talk to anyone, and you'd better stay quiet. As for how I know... I'm just guessing that maybe she functions in the same way as a chimera!

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: Lady Hysilens's violin now sounds sweet and romantic, too. We made a promise that if we got any patients with insomnia in the future, a cup of goat-milk floral tea combined with her songs would be guaranteed to work as a cure!

quotes.title: About Cerydra
quotes.text: Ah, Lady Cerydra... While she showed her "tyrannical" side to the world, was there anyone there to cure her lonely heart? The next time I see her, I've gotta give her another big hug...

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: Just like how we are in the Flame-Chasing team, Sevie must be the person who cheers everyone up in the Trailblazing group. Look, (Trailblazer) is now a lot more relaxed with Miss March here!

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: I'm guessing that Cyrene must also really like sparkly things... because she's always gazing up at the stars in the sky. Don't you think so too, Little Ica? Yep! She must also like you, with how soft you are~

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: Little gray fry... I imagine there must be many who wish to stay close to you. The current that follows in your wake is unlike any other. It's like the warmth of a safe harbor, and comforting as if stepping ashore upon an island.

quotes.title: About Cerydra
quotes.text: Most rulers I've known were adept at slipping poison into goblets, yet the Imperator poured oil over the king's standard. That blazing banner... Its heat and light could reach you, even from the ocean's abyss.

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: Ever since inheriting divine authority, she has endured the agony of her humanity slipping away. Yet she chooses to bear it all with an alert mind, refusing to drown herself in numb indulgence... I don't think I could do the same.

quotes.title: About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon
quotes.text: Even as I shared chilling tales from the deep sea, they answered with those endearing, dolphin-like voices. Perhaps only such pure hearts can truly wash away the world's corruption.

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: A nimble little kitten fish that won't be caught by even the most tempting bait... yet. Perhaps one day, she will grow into a giant of the sea.

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: She's like... a wonderful warm-ocean concerto, blending glaciers and silt into harmony. With this little sea hare by your side, even the deep sea would hesitate to turn cold.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
quotes.text: Mountains are often silent and still, yet the resolve they bear needs no loud words to be known.

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: I've tried the red drink that that little sea lion is fond of... For a fish, the flavor of that pink juice is indeed... a bit light. As for Phagousa's honey brew, the little sea lion tried one cup and then refused to drink any more. He seems to think it's... unhealthy?

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: The purple little butterflyfish... I like the poems she writes. I even composed melodies of the deep ocean to accompany them. Let us sing those beautiful songs together in the future, when we feast in reunion.

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: That sage, agile like a green dolphin... His "performances" are awe-inspiring. Although, if they were accompanied by some music and deep-sea honey brew, they would surely be even more enchanting to all who listen.

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: That little healer fish, as gentle as a pearl, likes to wave her wand and make a grand spectacle of bubbles for me to play with. And thus... I am able to enjoy that childlike delight once more.

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: Even if the night came in the very next moment, that blue-gold sunfish would still burn himself up to become everyone else's light. I pray that he may swim more easily in this now-cleansed sea.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: What a marvel that this pink little jellyfish was able to tame the countercurrents of Time... Her light is so lively and warm that even I can't help but follow where she goes.

quotes.title: About the Astral Express
quotes.text: The actions and desires of the Nameless are always sincere. When dealing with you, the same sincerity is the most fitting price.

quotes.title: About Aventurine
quotes.text: Young people grow up so fast. In the blink of an eye, they reach the age where they start snatching work from the grown-ups.

quotes.title: About Topaz
quotes.text: She is still a work in progress. But one day she'll stop and realize... the first principle of negotiating a deal is to keep pressing after a victory.

quotes.title: About Sparkle
quotes.text: Not everyone can appreciate this kind of gemstone — the more unrefined and unbridled it is, the more beautiful... But it's too early to unearth now.

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: The world is fair. He must be prepared to lose however much he desires to gain.

quotes.title: About Pearl
quotes.text: Portraying the management of Planarcadia as art, and marketing the most sentimental art as profitable business... The terrifying thing about her is exactly this "ambition" she remains oblivious to.

quotes.title: About Aventurine • Waveflair
quotes.text: I've heard that the waters run deep and the tides are turbulent in Astropolis. Only truly fearless surfers can ride the tides at ease. I hope he'll return from this trip as fulfilled as always.

quotes.title: About Feixiao
quotes.text: General Feixiao is my benefactor and patient. A doctor's life belongs to his patient. I cannot leave this world before she's cured.

quotes.title: About Moze
quotes.text: My duty is to heal the general, and Moze's duty is to suppress her eagerness. That's why I'm in charge of cooking and medicine, and Moze handles all the dirty work. You see, neither of us can slack off.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: How much of that smile of his is genuine, how much of it is hiding something — Every time I see him, I can't help but wonder. Of course, this isn't his problem. It's mine.

quotes.title: About Huaiyan
quotes.text: In the entire Alliance, Huaiyan is the most inscrutable of the generals. I've worked with him on more than a few occasions, but I can never seem to figure him out.

quotes.title: About Sushang
quotes.text: When I first met Sushang, she was still in Suyi's arms, sucking her thumb. It feels like it was just yesterday when I was helping her skip classes and being scolded by Suyi... I'm getting old.

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: I didn't expect to see someone his age still using a sword as a toy... From generation to generation, it seems some things never change.

quotes.title: About Yunli
quotes.text: Miss Yunli may be the second youngest member of the Flamewheel Octet, but she is no less a swordsmaster than the other seven. Some might suspect her of benefitting from her connection to Huaiyan, but she could not have endured such rigor and refinement if she were not a valuable talent in her own right.

quotes.title: About Fu Xuan
quotes.text: Anyone who says the master diviner is eccentric should pay a visit to her home world, the Xianzhou Yuque. That's the heartland of the followers of the Wisdomwalker. I'm guessing every conversation on the Yuque is some permutation of "he knows that you know that I know that he knows..."

quotes.title: About Yukong
quotes.text: Like Helm Master Yukong, after the war 30 years ago, I've grown weary of fighting.

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: I hope that she actually enjoys the art of medicine, and that it's not just a responsibility imposed on her... But that seems to be a predicament most Vidyadhara have to grapple with.

quotes.title: About Lingsha
quotes.text: Head of the Alchemy Commission is not a position that can be filled with just a handful of good medical skills — even with the right skills, filling the position and holding it are two entirely different matters.

quotes.title: About Guinaifen
quotes.text: Guinaifen might not realize it, but by living her life like a roaring fire, she also illuminates the lives of others... like the little flame under a hot pot.

quotes.title: About Xueyi and Hanya
quotes.text: Those two sisters epitomize the failures of the Xianzhou Alliance — no one can live well and no one can die well. If even death is a luxury, then what kind of monsters have we become?

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: If you treat him as a child, he'll put on the airs of an adult. If you treat him as an adult, he'll show the temperament of a child.

quotes.title: About Fu Xuan
quotes.text: I know what Fu Xuan is thinking of, so I must make her wait. If she is patient enough to wait, then that would be the time.

quotes.title: About Yukong
quotes.text: Everyone believes Helm Master Yukong had retired... They don't know that she chose an even harder path after she left her beloved skies behind.

quotes.title: About Tingyun
quotes.text: Xianzhou is capable of such bustling trade because of how Amicassadors such as Tingyun socialize so much with the outsiders.

quotes.title: About Luocha
quotes.text: I have seen many merchants in my life, but don't you think there aren't many like him, who are in no hurry to do business?

quotes.title: About Sushang
quotes.text: That carefree new Cloud Knight recruit, huh... I was like that once upon a time, but it was a long while ago.

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: It's hard being the High Elder of the Vidyadhara... I hope she remains well in this lifetime.

quotes.title: About Jingliu
quotes.text: She taught me the skills with a blade, but we never became close... *sigh* In an endless night, there is nothing closer than the bright moon, always hanging in the sky.

quotes.title: About Blade
quotes.text: If he were to forget everything, it would make things a lot easier for me.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: I understand the one I wished to trace... exists now only in memory. But it's probably what's best for him.

quotes.title: About the Crew
quotes.text: The Cloudstrider's chromatic echelon has departed once again, and the renewed connection of all worlds is imminent. This is good news for the Alliance... but now that the Star Rail is clear, what action will be taken by the fiends and demons once stranded in that remote corner? ...Alas, another problem for another day.

quotes.title: About the Ten-Lords Commission
quotes.text: A sword without a sheath is nothing more than a lethal weapon. The Ten-Lords Commission is the sheath that reigns in our long lives, the yoke that binds itself to us, and the law by which our merits and sins are judged.

quotes.title: About Yunli
quotes.text: I recall that she is the adopted granddaughter of General Huaiyan. She has excellent swordsmanship and is about the same age as Yanqing — it would be ideal if the two could get along well and learn from each other.

quotes.title: About Jiaoqiu
quotes.text: The way I see it, he was always a healer. It's just that ordinary healers focus on one patient at a time, while he wanted to cure the ailments of all the people on the Xianzhou.

quotes.title: About Lingsha
quotes.text: I do shoulder much of the blame for the current state of the Alchemy Commission. I am deeply grateful that she is willing to let go of past grudges and come back to the Luofu to save the Commission from collapse.

quotes.title: About Feixiao
quotes.text: The Merlin's Claw and I couldn't be more different in terms of temperament and how we handle things, but our perspectives on many issues are quite similar... It's interesting if you think about it.

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: Madam Yao appears to bear a youthful mind, yet in truth she is keenly perceptive. Her words of contest with me are proof enough that, she acknowledges my ability. And her frequent mention of past affairs serves only to show that, since then, no further conflict has arisen.

quotes.title: About Mortenax Blade
quotes.text: He was once a master swordsmith, and by circumstance became deathless... only he could forge his own flesh into a blade... It could only be him.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: I wouldn't say he's a natural swordmaster... but being gifted shouldn't be a determining factor when choosing an apprentice. Mentors who place importance on natural talent either lack the skills to teach, or seek to take credit for their apprentices' easy success. Fame, background... none of those matter. I will teach my techniques to anyone willing to put their heart into them.

quotes.title: About Blade
quotes.text: I put him under great pain and suffering when I taught him. On the day his skills are perfected, he vows to return the favor. I look forward to it.

quotes.title: About Dan Feng
quotes.text: To take the throne, the high elder of the Vidyadhara needs to pass a series of trials during which their physical features slowly transform to resemble that of their predecessors. I see that loss of identity as a curse, rather than a gift. He managed to break free eventually, but should have done it in a different way...

quotes.title: About Baiheng
quotes.text: We talked about the stars we flew past, the views we saw together, and the dangers we escaped. But... I can't remember the details. The things we said and did together have all been shrouded in a layer of mist... a mist I cannot see through...

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: He is still a fledgling, but I see great potential. Still, one cannot truly understand swordsmanship without sustaining injury and drawing blood in the thick of battle...

quotes.title: About Luocha
quotes.text: He is just like me... There is a hole in his heart. No matter what he does to fill it, the hole remains. The harder he tries, the more exhausted he becomes.

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: Our words on the Yuque were less than cordial. Yet I know we are much the same... in striving toward our goals, we abandon what must be abandoned.

quotes.title: About Mortenax Blade
quotes.text: I'll be waiting... for the day he comes to take his revenge on me.

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf
quotes.text: I like chatting with Silver Wolf. She's got a lot of ideas for someone so small.

quotes.title: About Blade
quotes.text: Bladie... He takes after his name — his fights are a pleasure to witness.

quotes.title: About Sam
quotes.text: Oh, Sam isn't nearly as picky about his prey as I am... you might consider it a lucky break running into me.

quotes.title: About Firefly
quotes.text: I suppose all we can do is keep each other company... for a while.

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf LV.999
quotes.text: I know. She always wanted to bring her ideas to life, unfettered. So I hope she enjoys herself this time.

quotes.title: About Mortenax Blade
quotes.text: He has always been the sharpest edge among the Stellaron Hunters. But from this day on, his "fate" lies in his own hand, like a sword he alone wields.

quotes.title: About Huaiyan
quotes.text: I would not consider myself close to General Huaiyan, but I have prepared incense for him before. Don't be fooled by the old general's usual cheerful demeanor... When he gets angry, it's like there's steam coming out of his ears.

quotes.title: About Yunli
quotes.text: Yunli's scent is fresh and sweet, just like frankincense. When she comes to see me, she's like a little animal, crawling onto my lap. Who could resist leaning down and taking in a deep breath? Even just thinking about it makes me happy...

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: My master and General Jing Yuan have an... unpleasant history with each other. But personal grudges are a luxury that adults cannot afford!

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: The smell of this Luofu swordmaster is as pure as his character — I only detect the scent of rain. Hmm, does this mean that his will is pure, or that he is too naive?

quotes.title: About Yunhua
quotes.text: My master was framed by criminals, in a sense because she was a kind and open soul. When faced with villains who would destroy everything, you must not harbor any good will.

quotes.title: About Feixiao
quotes.text: I once witnessed her in battle with my own eyes. She is more like a warrior than a general. There used to be a faint scent of fear beneath her boldness and willingness to charge into life-or-death situations, but now that is almost gone.

quotes.title: About Jiaoqiu
quotes.text: If it looks like a hot pot, smells like a hot pot, and acts like a hot pot... I can only diagnose him as being a hot pot.

quotes.title: About Moze
quotes.text: His scent is so faint it's almost imperceptible, but it also carries a pungent smell of rust. He must have many stories to tell.

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: In the art of healing, I certainly could not compare to the Luofu's high elder. But in these games of politics, I still take pride in being able to protect her.

quotes.title: About Yukong
quotes.text: The war thirty years ago changed many people. The scent of sorrow always surrounds her now. Although I have not seen her in many years, smells do not lie — Yukong is still the same Yukong, even if she herself does not realize it.

quotes.title: About Fu Xuan
quotes.text: Diviner Fu comes to me asking for sugary drinks whether she is ill or not. I've told her many times that drinking too much has no health benefits, but she insists on drinking it anyway. She even says, "Not being able to have sugary drinks is bad for my health." What can you do...

quotes.title: About Qingque
quotes.text: Since returning to the Luofu, I've been buried in work. There are only three things that bring me joy: eating food, making perfumes, and teasing Qingque.

quotes.title: About Huohuo
quotes.text: Even on the Zhuming, it's rare to see a soldier and a heliobus have such a symbiotic relationship, as if they are of one heart and mind. This soft-scented girl is really something~

quotes.title: About Tail
quotes.text: The Luofu really is a bit conservative. If we encountered a heliobus on the Zhuming that was this capable and had no harmful intentions, we would definitely not seal it up.

quotes.title: About Natasha
quotes.text: Unless my injuries are serious, I try my best not to bother Natasha. Too many people need her help, they shouldn't have to suffer for my carelessness.

quotes.title: About Seele
quotes.text: Seele... Now, how can I coax her into joining the tournament? With her strength, she'll easily be crowned champion... unless she meets me! Ha!

quotes.title: About Svarog
quotes.text: Gotta find an opportunity to beat that tinhead in an arm wrestle... Huh? You thought I was serious? Well, maybe the right arm...

quotes.title: About Sampo
quotes.text: I don't need a middleman. Plus, anyone who calls themself "tall, blue, and handsome" definitely can't be trusted.

quotes.title: About Hook
quotes.text: Everyone says Hook is too naughty, but I think she's a good kid. An example? Uh... guess I don't have any — just my gut feeling. Tsk, what do you mean "spoken like a true honorary member of The Moles"!?

quotes.title: About Oleg
quotes.text: ...Oh, uh, never mind — I was just wondering how much training I've got left before I can finally beat Master Oleg. I need to hurry up — if he gets too old it won't be impressive anymore!

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: Not only is the general an expert in perceiving people's intentions, but he is also a master of the arts of concealment and showmanship. When he decides to "show" something, it's time to be careful.

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: Oh, you mean the young boy? The one who's always by the general? I don't know anything about him...

quotes.title: About Yukong
quotes.text: Unlike her, very few can realize that they are nothing but a tiny mustard seed in this vast galaxy... She is worthy of my respect.

quotes.title: About Tingyun
quotes.text: It's hard to forget anything Tingyun says. The Foxians' talent with words should be utilized to its maximum potential, no?

quotes.title: About Sushang
quotes.text: She's kind and always willing to help. She invited me to "tea and storytelling" the next time I'm on the Xianzhou. I'm not so sure about the storytelling — sounds time-consuming.

quotes.title: About Jingliu
quotes.text: That sword she holds in her heart has long since split heaven and earth... but having harnessed that kind of power, she is no longer a mere master of the sword.

quotes.title: About Bronya
quotes.text: It must be very tiring for Miss Bronya to have to deal with so many people every day.

quotes.title: About Serval
quotes.text: I actually admire her for her many talents... Don't tell her I said that.

quotes.title: About Gepard
quotes.text: My brother is a very capable and very good man... It would be nice if he didn't worry so much about me.

quotes.title: About Pela
quotes.text: There are many things that only Pela can understand... Hehe.

quotes.title: About Sampo
quotes.text: He seems to be a wanted criminal that my brother is tracking, but I feel like I see him occasionally in the Snow Plains... Ah! Is HE the legendary Belobog Caveman!?

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: ...Dan Heng got on the train before me. He never mentioned his past... If you get the chance, why don't you ask him about it?

quotes.title: About Dan Heng 2
quotes.text: Even after we found out about his mysterious past, he's still the same Dan Heng we've always known!

quotes.title: About Himeko
quotes.text: Ahh, beautiful Himeko. She's sensible, reliable, and elegant. It's great to have her as the navigator... When I'm grown up, I'm gonna be just like her! I like the now me too though~

quotes.title: About Welt
quotes.text: I heard Mr. Yang was once the leader of a secret organization and saved a whole planet! Not to mention he's been a teacher, and even a storyboard artist! *sigh* He must be an alien or something...

quotes.title: About Pom-Pom
quotes.text: The conductor is the best!

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: Master Yanqing has very rigorous teaching style. He's always saying "that's what the general taught me back in the day," ...Looks like everything General Jing Yuan taught him he knows by heart.

quotes.title: About Yunli
quotes.text: Master Yunli has a very freestyle approach to teaching. The thing she always says to me is: "You just feel it!" Maybe that's what they call experiential guidance?

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: I wonder how the conductor would react if they heard about his "seven rest days" proposal.

quotes.title: About Evernight
quotes.text: Sometimes I imagine myself being all cool, mysterious, elegant, and powerful, making enemies go flying with just a flick of the wrist... But I never thought that'd come true! Next time, I'm gonna use my own power to protect everyone!

quotes.title: About Dan Heng 3
quotes.text: We both made huge progress on this Amphoreus adventure, I'd say it's a draw! Hmm... wait. He made that progress way before I did, so... Okay okay, he wins... but just by a hair!

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: My daily style improved so much after Lady Aglaea gave me some pointers. As expected from everyone's guide and mentor!

quotes.title: About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon
quotes.text: Tribbie may be small, but they have lots of energy! I didn't want to disappoint them, so I practiced for a super long time and finally memorized Oronyx's prayer! You don't believe me? Hmph. I'll recite it for you then...

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: Mydeimos seems so... cool and aloof, but he's actually really friendly... How does that work? I don't really get it... Guess I just understand girls more than I understand guys, huh.

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: Miss Castorice makes soft and fragrant plushies, writes exhilarating stories, and even smells super nice every time she walks by... I learn so much every time I hang out with her.

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: I was, um, actually born with a fear of teachers... but he's the exception! Whenever I don't get a concept, he uses dromases as an analogy, and then I instantly get it!

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: I don't know how, but we became super good friends even though we haven't known each other for a long time. The last time I went to her courtyard, we talked about everything from Taikiyan to Amphoreus, and drank pots and pots of floral tea, and ate one honeycake after another. Little Ica even fell asleep... but we still didn't feel like that chat was long enough!

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: It's super fun to listen to Miss Cipher! She's told me at least eighty versions of the story of the Meow-Meow faith and the Woof-Woof faith. That's almost more than the number of backstories I've made up for myself!

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: The sound of Lady Hysilens's violin is more intoxicating than honey brews... Could it be that the trick to becoming elegant and beautiful is to learn a musical instrument? Hmm. It's time for me to learn something as well and improve myself!

quotes.title: About Cerydra
quotes.text: My heart was in my throat when I played Aero-Chess with the Imperator! But not only did she allow me to take back my moves, she even seriously considered my suggestions... Hehe, I even managed to snag a win at the end!

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: He suffered through so much agony but still managed to stay true to his wish... I need to be able to do that, too!

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: I won't forget how Cyrene protected all the memories and kept watch over the future... because that's how we make all the sacrifices worthwhile!

quotes.title: About Himeko • Nova
quotes.text: As expected of the beautiful and reliable Himeko, she's actually "evolved" again! I really want to meet her friend "Motoko." Seriously, if I could hang out with two such absolute icons every day, I'd be the luckiest girl alive!

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: The job at The Reverie can get pretty hectic, but it's also how I get to meet interesting new friends like you, (Trailblazer)!

quotes.title: About Robin
quotes.text: The songs of Miss Robin have the power to carry people to faraway places, beyond even the most beautiful dreams. I... I'll always be a fan of Miss Robin!

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: Well, despite his young age, Mr. Sunday is already big deal in Penacony. Just watching him from afar can make you feel overwhelmed...

quotes.title: About Gallagher
quotes.text: It's typical to see Gallagher immersed in his work on the streets of Penacony. He's always been so responsible and committed.

quotes.title: About the Nameless
quotes.text: Grandpa told me, it's never too late to have a dream, he said what matters is how much you aspire to make it come true. I'll never forget this — there will come a day when I'll make both my and Grandpa's dreams a reality!

quotes.title: About Clockie
quotes.text: Let me tell you a secret, Clockie is actually real, he isn't just an imaginary friend I made up!

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: I knew little of you before, until you set foot on another path, one called "Trailblaze."

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf
quotes.text: My hand's healed quite a bit. I should be able to keep my promise and play with her this time. Still, I won't be nearly as skilled with a controller as I am with a sword.

quotes.title: About Firefly
quotes.text: In a final blaze, we parted with the past. Yet where we go from here remains uncertain.

quotes.title: About Kafka
quotes.text: She has done much to suppress the mara. Now that I've broken my shackles, it's time I help her fulfill her wish.

quotes.title: About Elio
quotes.text: Elio only cares about two things: the cost, and the outcome.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: When will he stop hiding behind his role as a general and confront his past?

quotes.title: About Jingliu
quotes.text: The wounds she left have long since healed. But the blade I wield will never forget.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: The debts Imbibitor Lunae owes... he has repaid many of them. But the past cannot be so easily erased.

quotes.title: About Evanescia
quotes.text: She walks beside me in the fight against "immortality."

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: We once believed miracles would always happen. That's what led to disaster... I hope she's thought through the consequences.

quotes.title: About Ashveil
quotes.text: When I was young, he tried to convince me to leave with him and become a ranger. But I chose to stay and forge swords. If I had gone with him... There are no "ifs" in life.

quotes.title: About Huaiyan
quotes.text: Ever since I left the forge behind and became a hunter, I've felt unworthy to face my master. But when this is over, if I return with what I've forged... maybe I won't let him down.

quotes.title: About Feixiao 1
quotes.text: Feixiao is a personal "enemy" who took the lives of my "family members," but she is also a personal savior who gave me a new life.

quotes.title: About Feixiao 2
quotes.text: Feixiao allows me to try to "assassinate" her at any time. She uses me as a dagger with which to sharpen her senses. This is how she shows her trust in me, but to this day, I have not won a single time.

quotes.title: About Jiaoqiu
quotes.text: He says the general is his patient, but I think the general is actually his doctor.

quotes.title: About Sushang
quotes.text: I ran into her in the barracks a few years ago, but she didn't recognize me. I was an advisor to Feixiao at that time and often had to go to Jiaoqiu's home. How could she have not seen me?

quotes.title: About Huaiyan
quotes.text: That old man is quite capable. Anyone who has lived that long and isn't sick of himself must be quite capable.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: He doesn't seem to enjoy his work, but he has still dutifully done it until now. In this way, he is like me.

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: We gathered together under Aglaea's direction, not because of her cunning, but because there's a blazing fire in her cold eyes that is destined to ignite.

quotes.title: About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon
quotes.text: The prophecy brought by Lady Tribios is not so much fate as it is a form of hope. In this fractured era, believe in your own choices, and then give it your all.

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: I've fought him several times, battling for dozens of days and nights without a clear victor. I know the strength of this man, and because of that, he is worthy to have my back.

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: The Death Servant of Aidonia... she is destined to carry the Coreflame of Thanatos. I hope that at the end of the black tide, on the other side of the warm west wind, is also a sea of flowers.

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: I've heard more than a dozen sins attributed to him, but a certain good student from the Grove loves to talk about how wonderful that scholar is as a teacher... Anyone capable of leaving such an impression on him is likely someone I'd appreciate as well.

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: Nikador and Aquila had fought a long divine war in the past, and now the representatives of Sky and Strife stand as comrades. This is proof that humanity can overcome the gods.

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: Before I came to Okhema, I had heard from the Kremnoan children about a thief who came and went as they pleased, often playing with the children. Sometimes, they would tell the children where the juiciest fruits could be found. Other times, they warned of where the black tide would strike. Looking back now, it must have been her.

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: I also once fought against the malevolent tides of the Sea of Souls, and I know the taste of despair and deathly silence... Perhaps that is why the deep sea's honey brew has such a bitter and intense flavor.

quotes.title: About Cerydra
quotes.text: We've both made very difficult choices for our city-states and people. However, no matter how painful it is to cast out the old and bring in the new, it's the road a worthy ruler must one day take.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: With the will of a Nameless, she'll definitely be able to confront and overcome the shadows of her past.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
quotes.text: The powers of the earth have sharpened his spear. If given the chance, I'd love to spar with him and learn more of the way of the lance.

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: The great efforts and sacrifices she made for Amphoreus will make this broken and charred land flourish with prosperous cities.

quotes.title: About Seele
quotes.text: Seele's already become a capable adult — I can't treat her like a child anymore.

quotes.title: About Clara
quotes.text: I heard she's been looking after the wounded vagrants. What a girl... When I first met Clara, she was replacing parts for her robots like a mechanic, but leaving her own wounds unattended. It was heartbreaking to watch.

quotes.title: About Svarog
quotes.text: Svarog wants to preserve humanity, but he's not concerned about what humans truly think.

quotes.title: About Sampo
quotes.text: If I know Sampo, the last thing he wants is to owe you a favor — he'll think of any way possible to pay you back... The longer you leave a favor, the harder it is to calculate its value.

quotes.title: About Hook
quotes.text: Sometimes I stand at the door of the clinic and watch her running and jumping around... and my tiredness simply goes away.

quotes.title: About Oleg
quotes.text: We both came from the Overworld. Maybe that's why we're so eager to turn back the clock — to return to when life below ground was no harder than life on the surface.

quotes.title: About Luka
quotes.text: That kid puts up a strong front, but under the surface he's afraid of becoming a burden — that's why he trains and fights so hard... I hope one day he's able to slow down and listen to his heart.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: You naturally draw in gazes full of "expectations" and "trust" in more than 80% of all social situations: this level of emotional projection usually requires a high level of social capital in exchange.

quotes.title: About Aventurine
quotes.text: All probability extrapolations related to tasks he's involved in will temporarily malfunction. However, he does not seem to care that much about winning in casual parties, where he can momentarily let down his guard.

quotes.title: About Aventurine • Waveflair
quotes.text: Observation: Not a single step taken in the Ten Stonehearts' chess game is a wasted move. By riding upon the tip of a dangerous wave, what storms shall he create in the future?

quotes.title: About Jade
quotes.text: I will help her to appraise the fakes in her collection, and in exchange, I can pick a single piece of artwork from her treasures to take with me... It's a pity that such opportunities are not easy to come by.

quotes.title: About Topaz
quotes.text: As demonstrated by 89% of business records: Jelena's actions arise from her abundant emotions and willpower. I like this about her, but I often remind her not to be wielded as a blade by someone else.

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: I believe: For a general who has turned herself into the compass of fate, she will not be doomed to "losing her way" in that unperceivable sea of possibilities.

quotes.title: About Ashveil
quotes.text: Putting aside our roles as employer and hunter, his intuition often brings me supreme inspiration. However, whenever I try to press for more details, he would never divulge more than necessary... I guess this is akin to leaving adequate "blank space" in art.

quotes.title: About Sparxie
quotes.text: Numerous imitations of "Sparxie" are still flooding the internet in Planarcadia. This proves that repetition is one of humanity's defining traits. It also proves: she still has an acute grasp of human nature.

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf LV.999
quotes.text: Over the years, I've compiled and analyzed vast amounts of her data. Without exception, every predictive curve fitted from it points toward a frontier no one has ever reached.

quotes.title: About Evanescia
quotes.text: Several colleagues view the IPC as Planarcadia's commanding authority, but Planarcadia and its people have always followed a logic of their own. The will to protect that she has displayed deserves far more of our respect.

quotes.title: About Nihilux
quotes.text: When we spoke about The Fluffy's next topic, she often commented, "You're starting to sound too commercial." I work in investment, but I still retain the refined tastes of an artist. I truly enjoy it the most when inspiration strikes while discussing the comic's "iconic scenes" with her.

quotes.title: About Himeko
quotes.text: In all of my calculations, Trailblazing remains an unknown variable. Yet for one who can find their bearing in that chaos and light the way forward, I am willing to place in them the greatest trust I can offer.

quotes.title: About Graphia
quotes.text: I once found her existence perplexing: a creation of the Destruction, yet devoted to the art of creating life. But as I traced the strokes of her brush, I came to understand. That will, burning like blood and fire, had already become a bold splash of color cast defiantly against fate.

quotes.title: About Yabuli
quotes.text: Evil done in the name of the Preservation will always be more vile than outright malice and destruction. Risking my entire career to eliminate the root of evil is the best solution I've come up with after countless calculations.

quotes.title: About Bronya
quotes.text: In all of Belobog, you won't find anyone who speaks more elegantly or acts more like a leader than Lady Bronya.

quotes.title: About Serval
quotes.text: *sigh* Serval's rule is: No rules.

quotes.title: About Gepard
quotes.text: Captain Gepard is an honorable man and very reliable. But when it comes to his horticultural skills... all I can say is I respect his effort and wish him the best of luck.

quotes.title: About Lynx
quotes.text: Lynxy is one of my... Uh, Lynx is one of my... Ahem! Lynx is... one of Belobog's number one researchers, and... one of my best besties!

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer) 1
quotes.text: I've learned much from you about the essence of "Trailblazing." Exploring the Cosmos, bridging worlds... If it weren't for my duties, I'd gladly try my hand at being a Nameless!

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer) 2
quotes.text: ...The composition of our existences may be fundamentally different, but the "heart" that beats within us both burns with the same heat.

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: She always said that she hoped for the world to no longer need a Deliverer. She must've known deep down that, as long as there are still people who love this world, a Deliverer is destined to appear.

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: Many said that her heart is a void, filled with nothing. Yet, this seeming emptiness was needed to encompass the wishes of an entire world.

quotes.title: About Tribbie, Trianne, and Trinnon
quotes.text: They created history, recounted history, and became a part of history... But they have never let the passage of time erode their resolve. I should do the same.

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: He never says what he thinks, but his simple and heavy feelings are always evident — so simple that they contain nothing except his home, and so heavy that they are reduced to nothing except sighs... Maybe that's why we became kindred spirits.

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: She taught us that death can be warm, graceful, and kind... Shouldn't life, then, be even more so?

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: "The man cursed by Mnestia" — The professor often referred to me this way, and I took it in stride. After all, the courage to be unique is a virtue I learned from him.

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: Every time I visit that sunlit courtyard, the gentle light through the latticed windows evokes the image of my homeland's sprawling wheat fields. In these end times, the hope she gives is far more precious than any medicine or healing.

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: She teased Death, toyed with Strife, and single-handedly upheld her Trickery. Her endurance and unrestrained spirit are truly admirable.

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: After waiting in solitude for so long, we were both able to see the arrival of the hero who would break the cycle. Every second that passed during that wait will be fermented by time and turned into a blazing and potent final brew.

quotes.title: About Cerydra
quotes.text: With the golden blood of countless beings, she etched the mark of heroes upon the ages. Though I did not walk with them, the great cause of the Flame-Chase would have long died without her sacrifices.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: A person may have many names over their lifetime. Whether hers is "Evernight" or "March 7th," I hope her colors never fade with the passage of time.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
quotes.text: He always gives out this trustworthy feeling of "he'll stand with you no matter what." That's what you expect out of a Nameless.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: I heard the general often listens to music with his eyes closed. Can we promote that in the Divination Commission? Thank you, general.

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: I've heard his name. A genius boy, and working every day at such a young age? Sounds exhausting.

quotes.title: About Fu Xuan
quotes.text: As soon as I have free time, the master diviner immediately appears and gives me mundane jobs to do... It looks like I need to work on time management more...

quotes.title: About Yukong
quotes.text: She's a big shot from the Sky-Faring Commission who can't rest even after retiring from the front lines. It's hard being a powerful official.

quotes.title: About Tingyun
quotes.text: I saw Tingyun stopping in front of the games parlor once, so I invited her to play a round. Tingyun is pretty and her play is entertaining. People crowded around the game table that day and the mood was on fire. The owner lost all his money — it was great to watch.

quotes.title: About Luocha
quotes.text: Who? That sounds like an outsider... We've got a lot of outsiders. You'll come across them a lot in The Looking Bronze. He's probably here to seek success in "Seeking Immortality" for himself... Yes, I did say "seek" twice.

quotes.title: About Sushang
quotes.text: A newcomer with the Cloud Knights? *sigh* Just go back to where she's from. Everything is so competitive here in the Luofu. You can't get promoted.

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: I got a bit too excited playing Celestial Jade once and sprained my wrist — a friend recommended her to me. I had my doubts at first, but as soon as she'd written out my prescription, she took out a Celestial Jade set. She told me to practice stacking the tiles to improve wrist flexibility. Naturally, I instantly respected her.

quotes.title: About Guinaifen
quotes.text: Guinaifen... Oh, you mean Little Gui! Every time I lose at celestial jade, I go watch her acrobatics performance to cheer me up. It's just... I never have enough strale to give her a tip...

quotes.title: About Huohuo
quotes.text: Every time I spot that kid, I can't help but feel this intense need to teach her how to play Celestial Jade. I've got to teach her the ins and outs...

quotes.title: About Xueyi
quotes.text: You know that book "An Unsuitable Job for A Puppet?" I didn't just read it, I even scribbled down some notes. Shame, though, I still don't have a clue who wrote it...

quotes.title: About Lingsha
quotes.text: The Cauldron Master is the worst! A few times when we were chatting, she suddenly said, "The master diviner is coming." I ran behind her to hide, only to find out that no one was actually coming! She's always teasing me like that, so infuriating...

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: Playing against superiors is the worst! Winning feels bad, losing feels even worse, the whole thing's torture. But with Madam Yao laying down that kind of pressure... I've got no choice but to go all out.

quotes.title: About Lord Silvergun Shura
quotes.text: The bullet of Lord Silvergun Shura seals throats far and wide. The will of Silvergun Shura is indestructible. If you fire at his will with the bullet of Silvergun Shura... Sorry, seems like the conversation went in an unexpected direction.

quotes.title: About the Ninja Hiryū
quotes.text: This person's ninjutsu is superb, and his eloquence is extraordinary, making him a ninja master of both literary and martial arts. I cannot yet attain his state of mind, so I must continue to practice!

quotes.title: About the Ninja Ruri
quotes.text: She once suffered from not knowing her origins but continued to forge ahead. As the Cosmic Ninjutsu Inscriptions read: "Life is fleeting, it exists within, not out, in departure, not arrival, in here, not elsewhere."

quotes.title: About the Ninja Gama
quotes.text: He traverses the visible world, compiling all things in search of the true way of the ninja. Yet all phenomena are mere illusions. As the Cosmic Ninjutsu Inscriptions read: "Dreams are dreamless, emptiness is not empty, neither coming nor going, only in the middle."

quotes.title: About the Ninja Singer
quotes.text: What a beautiful melody! When the singing begins, I too lament on the ground. The season of glory blooms only once in a lifetime. Alas, flowers and people come and go!

quotes.title: About the Evil Ninja Osaru
quotes.text: In the Mappou Age of the Dharma, the evil ninja thrives. Fortunately, no matter how powerful the Evil Ninja Osaru is, it is difficult to escape the law of birth and death. Those who are born must die, and karma will not be extinguished. The divine power of the Great Lan will eventually manifest.

quotes.title: About Mechanical Fever
quotes.text: The swift melody of the snow country's ninja music! Such melodious sounds are sure to sway like the spring breeze, quietly ascending to the white clouds above.

quotes.title: About the Red Oni With the Ninja Prosthetic Arm
quotes.text: To witness the duel of Lord Silvergun Shura, I once visited The Xianzhou Luofu. His opponent was Red Oni Ninja who used a ninja prosthetic arm, with a pure and unwavering fighting spirit, far from ordinary.

quotes.title: About Solostar Wolfshade
quotes.text: Solostar Wolfshade hides among the crowds. I was once fortunate enough to study the art of detection under him. Though he lacks the skills for deduction, he sees through people's hearts. And though he has not a single coin weighing him down, he carries an unimaginably heavy weight upon his soul.

quotes.title: About Saber
quotes.text: Back in the Holy Grail War I lived through, we were once bound as Master and Servant... It's always reassuring to have the King of Knights' legendary blade at your side.

quotes.title: About Lancer
quotes.text: Lancer might come across as a bit flippant, but he's actually a reliable big brother figure — a calm, tenacious warrior. Believe it or not, I actually owe him my life.

quotes.title: About Archer
quotes.text: That guy... Even here, he's still got that infuriating expression that says "I'll handle everything, leave it to me." And on top of that, he acts like he's my guardian. I swear, I'll find a way to put him in his place one of these days!

quotes.title: About Gilgamesh
quotes.text: Whether in the history books or that Holy Grail War, that Goldy is in a league of his own when it comes to being a troublemaker. If he ever finds out I've accepted Ishtar's blessing... I'm dead meat.

quotes.title: About Ishtar
quotes.text: She loves watching humans get into trouble, yet she can't bring herself to just look away... That's why she granted me her blessing, isn't it? Honestly, she's a benevolent goddess at heart, after all~

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: To shoulder the collective desires of all humanity... such a burden would eventually burn anyone to ash. Thank you, (Trailblazer), for staying by his side until the very end.

quotes.title: About Castorice and Polyxia
quotes.text: Those two sisters are so similar to Sakura and me, yet entirely different, almost like two mirrors reflecting one another... I'm grateful to them. They helped me find our most precious treasure.

quotes.title: About Ashveil
quotes.text: I never expected to be played by that detective... When it comes to scheming and disregarding everyone else's feelings, he's the spitting image of that King of Heroes.

quotes.title: About Kuchiba
quotes.text: I had a hunch Ms. Kuchiba was hiding some massive secret... but even after the Holy Grail War ended, we're still completely in the dark! Well, it makes sense. A key character from the main series can't go spilling all their secrets in a spin-off, can they?

quotes.title: About Herta
quotes.text: Madam Herta... A genius who commands the galaxy's attention, a trailblazer forging ahead on the Path of "Erudition"... My god, she's basically the ideal version of myself!

quotes.title: About Dr. Ratio
quotes.text: A scholar with real combat discipline is a rare breed indeed, let alone one who's honed both to such perfection. If I have the chance, I'll definitely have to pick his brain on both fronts!

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: My brother seems to believe that he should shoulder more responsibilities. He always listens carefully to my problems, but hardly ever confides in me... Perhaps in his eyes, I'm still his kid sister.

quotes.title: About Sunday 2
quotes.text: My brother has always been my protector, and I've never contemplated stepping out of his shadow... Yet even though we may take different paths, I am... still his little sister.

quotes.title: About Gallagher
quotes.text: Mr. Gallagher likes to keep his softer side hidden, and even though he might seem a little disorganized at times, he's always there for his friends when it matters most.

quotes.title: About Black Swan
quotes.text: Miss Black Swan's strategies and methods are as thorough and enchanting as her dancing. I look forward to the moment when we can dance together.

quotes.title: About Rappa
quotes.text: "When I was a child, my speech, mindset, and soul reflected immaturity and innocence. When I became an adult, I put away those childish aspects." — Miss Rappa always views the world through such a pure lens, untouched and uncorrupted.

quotes.title: About Mr. Reca
quotes.text: Mr. Reca is a film fanatic. I find some of his actions hard to understand, but I fully appreciate his dedication to the art of cinema. If we ever have the chance to collaborate again, I think we should focus on peaceful and heartwarming themes.

quotes.title: About Sunday 3
quotes.text: We all have to face reality after waking up from our dreams. Our... Brother's dream will also begin here.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: You always make choices so easily. Is it because of your experiences as a Nameless, or does your heart simply beat so freely and boldly?

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: I know my brother. Once he's decided on a path, he will never stray from it until he reaches the end. And now, it's time for me to set out toward a new horizon as well. I look forward to the day we stand side by side again at the same destination.

quotes.title: About Gopher Wood
quotes.text: When I was younger, Mr. Gopher Wood often encouraged us to make choices bravely and take on our responsibilities. "When all paths on the ground have been exhausted, birds must leave their footprints in the sky." Even if we err or fail... only by moving forward can we free ourselves from the manipulation of others.

quotes.title: About Aventurine • Waveflair
quotes.text: Think of the raging waves as a fun amusement park. Mr. Aventurine's numerous high-stakes games have taught me many unique rhythms.

quotes.title: About Herta
quotes.text: Some may find her personality unbearable — I can understand the sentiment, but I simply don't care. Of course, Herta knows this too, so I accepted her invitation.

quotes.title: About Screwllum
quotes.text: Screwllum and I have very different understandings of life, but I don't think he realizes it. Fortunately, our communication is limited to matters related to the Simulated Universe.

quotes.title: About Stephen
quotes.text: Put a watermelon parfait in Herta's office and Stephen is sure to show up. Remember, the pumpkin ones will never attract him — those are for warding him off.

quotes.title: About Fugue
quotes.text: She has simply proven once again that our understanding of the essence of life is still far from complete.

quotes.title: About The Herta
quotes.text: Her feedback is always sharp and brusque, especially when conversing face-to-face. However, I am never offended... We both know that every step taken beyond the boundaries of knowledge requires immense sacrifices.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: Though it is the Servant's duty to follow their Master's commands, I do hope we can appreciate and trust each other.

quotes.title: About Archer
quotes.text: That red-clad Archer and I share a deep connection. To have him on our side this time is a stroke of luck for both of us.

quotes.title: About Lancer
quotes.text: He's an exceptional warrior, though his temperament is... impetuous. Or rather, he possesses the wisdom to plan far ahead, yet still throw himself into battle with abandon... A keen thinker and dauntless warrior. That is the "Child of Light."

quotes.title: About Boothill
quotes.text: I've seen many people fueled by vengeance, only to have their souls shatter the moment their revenge is complete. I hope that once his revenge is fulfilled, he can still find a reason to exist in this world.

quotes.title: About Aventurine
quotes.text: Those who willingly place themselves in peril often lack strategy. Yet, he possesses a brilliance few can rival, all while chasing the uncontrollable thrill of facing death head-on... Perhaps he is, through and through, a "rational madman." A formidable fighter who doesn't care about winning or losing. That is truly fearsome.

quotes.title: About Robin
quotes.text: That girl may appear a delicate songstress, yet her heart is ever devoted to the well-being of others. I'm certain she has become an irreplaceable presence on the stage of Penacony.

quotes.title: About "Miss Note"
quotes.text: Though fate stripped her of her name and honor, I believe she is still a Heroic Spirit worthy of her title. Every Heroic Spirit, during their life as a human, endured great hardship. Yet through their actions, they lit the way for those who came after.

quotes.title: About Old Oti
quotes.text: The passage of endless years often erodes the soul, leaving one blind to what was once their guiding purpose. Perhaps this elder's prayer to the Holy Grail is not for power or glory, but for the fragments of a past slipping beyond his grasp.

quotes.title: About Rin Tohsaka
quotes.text: Compared to the Rin in my memories, she seems to hail from an entirely different world... Yet that strength, elegance, and resilience, and that radiant determination, is identical to the figure etched into my mind.

quotes.title: About Gilgamesh
quotes.text: You actually got the King of Heroes to step off his pedestal and help tackle the crisis... Color me impressed. But honestly, even with the might of all human history and wisdom on your side, putting up with his attitude is no easy feat... At least, I still haven't gotten used to it.

quotes.title: About Natasha
quotes.text: Back when I first arrived in the Underworld, I used to bring Natasha the medicines she needed. I did that for a while, and before long it was medicines and intel. You know how these things work.

quotes.title: About Svarog
quotes.text: If anyone out there ever managed to strike a deal with Svarog, they'd earn my heartfelt admiration!

quotes.title: About Clara
quotes.text: Our little girl in red is truly impressive. How did she get that giant tinhead to listen to her?

quotes.title: About Seele
quotes.text: If she had it her way, Miss Seele would spend less time yelling at me and more time actively trying to hit me. Can someone explain what I did to deserve her?

quotes.title: About Gepard
quotes.text: Ah, we see each other pretty often — usually it's me running away and him running after me. Gotta say, I'm gradually beginning to enjoy the attention, hehe.

quotes.title: About Serval
quotes.text: We used to be good pals, but now... Let's just say her brother put in a bad word for me.

quotes.title: About Bronya
quotes.text: My only wish is to get acquainted with the supreme guardian-to-be. Any introduction will do — even a painful one!

quotes.title: About Luka
quotes.text: Have you seen him compete? A lot of Underworlders made a lot of money off that kid! *sigh* Your pal Sampo here wasn't one of them...

quotes.title: About Sparkle
quotes.text: Think you've got her all figured out, do you? That's exactly what she wants you to think! Trust me, she's so cunning she could even outwit herself!

quotes.title: About Sparxie
quotes.text: Some people are so ruthless, they even fool themselves. And if there's anyone gullible enough to think she's done... well, be sure to let old Sampo know. I'd like to have a little "chat" with them.

quotes.title: About Natasha
quotes.text: I learned when I was a kid that temper tantrums won't get you anywhere with Nat... Let's just say she knew how to give you a taste of your own medicine.

quotes.title: About Clara
quotes.text: That girl doesn't talk much, but... I know she doesn't see us as her enemy.

quotes.title: About Svarog
quotes.text: Heh, Svarog's always going on about "humanity's endless conflicts," but you don't get peace by offering everything up on a silver platter.

quotes.title: About Sampo
quotes.text: If you need something done, he might be your man. But if you feel like befriending him, do yourself a favor: Don't.

quotes.title: About Hook
quotes.text: Don't let her appetite for chaos fool you — I think that kid's going places.

quotes.title: About Oleg
quotes.text: I probably owe my life to the chief.

quotes.title: About Bronya
quotes.text: It was the first time both of us had seen Belobog's real sky... the same sky.

quotes.title: About Luka
quotes.text: You think I'm too competitive? Ha, guess you haven't met Luka.

quotes.title: About Gepard
quotes.text: If he paid more attention to his affairs, it'd save me a lot of headaches... I guess I do create a few headaches for him too... Maybe we're even.

quotes.title: About Pela
quotes.text: She's a flower-growing drummer and a great report writer. Name a more reliable girl. I'll wait.

quotes.title: About Bronya
quotes.text: Bronya's a good kid — you can tell she learned a lot from Cocolia. *sigh* It's been a while since we saw each other. I miss her.

quotes.title: About Cocolia
quotes.text: The Cocolia I knew would sit on the roof and listen to my songs, but... not the supreme guardian.

quotes.title: About Sampo
quotes.text: Hah, that guy. One of these days he's gonna get busted by my brother.

quotes.title: About Lynx
quotes.text: Lynxy? ...She's more like me. Ah, don't tell my brother that, he hates hearing it.

quotes.title: About Kafka
quotes.text: Ignoring the rules is something Kafka and I have in common.

quotes.title: About Blade
quotes.text: He said he'd game with me once his hand healed up, but it seems like it still isn't any better.

quotes.title: About Screwllum
quotes.text: It is always me that has to make the first move... That guy never loses his cool, does he?

quotes.title: About Sam
quotes.text: Doing a mission with Sam is basically: Bang, bang...! Bang! And then it's over.

quotes.title: About Firefly
quotes.text: If Firefly's life was a game. It'd probably be a high-difficulty, single-player, action/speedrun thing... Everyone wants to play games like that, but no one wants a life like that.

quotes.title: About The Herta
quotes.text: I heard that no one has been able to find out where she lives? One day, I'll definitely break that myth.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: I kinda want to punch myself into memory loss too, just so I can re-roll my team comp and play through it all again. *sigh* I'm jealous. Unlocking all those side quests is way more fun than just following the main quest script like us.

quotes.title: About Blade
quotes.text: He's been dying to do this mission for a long time... But if you ask me, who's to say there isn't a hidden ending?

quotes.title: About Firefly
quotes.text: If you compare Firefly's life to a game, her play-style isn't as smooth as before... because for the first time, the character on screen is moving according to her own will.

quotes.title: About Kafka
quotes.text: It's not just you. Even I haven't seen her much lately. She'll complete the missions Elio assigns her, of course. But as for what's really going on in that head of hers... That's anybody's guess.

quotes.title: About Elio
quotes.text: Does Elio seriously not get me? As long as you win the final boss fight, losing once or a hundred times along the way is just part of the fun, isn't it?

quotes.title: About The Herta
quotes.text: I forget when it started, but she's been getting personally involved a lot more often. To be honest, that's not a good sign.

quotes.title: About Sparxie
quotes.text: Her livestreams are popular not because she's got good taste in games, but purely because she's entertaining to watch. It has absolutely nothing to do with whether the game is actually fun or not.

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: Someone who refuses to submit to destiny is either a god-like teammate or a nightmarish opponent.

quotes.title: About Ashveil
quotes.text: You watch him go stealth, lie in wait, and land a one-hit kill... but once he clears the stage, he just sighs and never logs in again. For someone like him, the journey is just too exhausting.

quotes.title: About Pearl
quotes.text: An artist who's too chicken to deal with wanted criminals can't possibly be a good IPC employee. Whoever said she doesn't understand the art of games?

quotes.title: About Evanescia
quotes.text: It's rare to run into such a hardcore fan. She knows about tons of retro games and comics. She's practically a living Planarcadia entertainment encyclopedia.

quotes.title: About Mortenax Blade
quotes.text: Mine is just a temporary overclock, so who should be envying whom?

quotes.title: About Himeko • Nova
quotes.text: Solo play and leading a raid are two completely different concepts. I've actually got a lot of respect for someone who can carry a whole team like that.

quotes.title: About Sampo
quotes.text: He's quite the entertaining one, and dependable when it comes to handling matters. The only thing with this guy is... he's got a line he won't cross... having limitations always kills the vibe!

quotes.title: About Black Swan
quotes.text: Graceful, entertaining, distinguished, yet dangerous... I'm just itching to bring someone like that down, but hey, her wrecking me... is totally on the table too!

quotes.title: About Aventurine
quotes.text: Seriously, who'd ditch an invite to our "tavern" to go rub shoulders with the corporation's drones? Still, if he'd simply become a friend, our relationship with him today would be far less interesting...

quotes.title: About Jade
quotes.text: She's like a puppeteer. It's as if people aren't people in her eyes... That kind of person is the most terrifying! But I can't help but want to work with her again and again... Why? Because I am also that kind of person.

quotes.title: About Sparxie
quotes.text: Even my spur-of-the-moment designs come out looking good. Just look! White hair with red highlights, and a rabbit mask I spent eleven system-hours perfecting! But they still need one final touch... a "Sparkling" heart~

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: Gray Hair, you know I'm totally your top fan, right? So... which show are we acting in together next?

quotes.title: About Sparkle
quotes.text: Those girls in plays... burning bright, dazzling, but gone in a flash... They used to be called "Sparkles"... Hehe, Sparkle and Sparxie, just pretty masks to wear~

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: Can you believe it? Lucky as can be and a true captain of a Xianzhou ship! Sounds like the perfect setup for an idol group, right? I'll handle the title song, and she'll twirl like a peacock. I'm thinking we'll go by the name "The Yao-Spark Hands."

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: Making people happy, and making people smile? Those are two totally different things! Heh, so what's Chicken Wing Boy gonna do, hmm?

quotes.title: About Ashveil
quotes.text: You really think people only wear one mask? Hah, no way... the clever ones play the fool, and the brave ones act like little nobodies... but he's no little nobody, hee-hee. Miss Sparxie's had him figured out since forever~ Awoo~ Do you realize how sad a wolf's unanswered howl really is?

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf LV.999
quotes.text: She clearly has the chops to be a game designer or a director, but she insists on making life hard for herself. *Sigh*... I was wondering why my electric buddy didn't hand me a script this time. Turns out she's decided to take center stage herself.

quotes.title: About Evanescia
quotes.text: Vibrant, effortlessly cool, gorgeous... sharp as a tack yet powerful, knows every trend inside and out, plus she's got killer internet instincts. She's basically every viral character trope rolled into one! Come on, even Director Sparxie wouldn't dare write a character like this. Where the heck did she learn all that?

quotes.title: About Himeko • Nova
quotes.text: Wait, what? A veteran player of the Phantasmoon Games? No fair, how am I even supposed to win against that? Hee-hee... but hey, if winning is off the table, that's fine too. At least let me chase some of that clout!

quotes.title: About Robin
quotes.text: I rarely discuss my worries with Robin. As the older brother, I should bear more responsibilities. The dark side of adulthood should not be brought back into our home.

quotes.title: About Robin 2
quotes.text: As children, we once made a wish together for "everyone to be happy"... Yet, the wish remains unfulfilled, and I already owe her so much... Perhaps at some point, I became one of her worries.

quotes.title: About Aventurine
quotes.text: He disguised himself with a superficial facade and gave us a grand performance. A respectable opponent. If there's still a chance for another clash on stage, I look forward to it.

quotes.title: About Dr. Ratio
quotes.text: Dullness and confusion are universal ailments. If not for our opposing positions, the professor and I would be able to get along.

quotes.title: About Gallagher
quotes.text: We were once adversaries, but his steadfast will and unwavering beliefs deserve my utmost respect.

quotes.title: About Welt
quotes.text: When the flames of an ideal are ignited within a person, they leave an indelible mark. That man must have a past worthy of being called "heroic."

quotes.title: About Himeko
quotes.text: The Trailblaze is not a solitary pursuit but a trajectory formed by generations connecting with each other... It's a path worthy of admiration.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: Wisdom has always had more than one face. Contemplation is a hallmark of intelligence, but so are quick thinking and intuition.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: Not everyone can move beyond their past. But once a person comes out of the fog, their stride will undoubtedly become more resolute.

quotes.title: About March 7th 2
quotes.text: I am glad to see that Miss March was able to bravely face the future with a brand-new outlook, and I admire her for it. There's still much I have to learn from her.

quotes.title: About Sparxie
quotes.text: To exaggerate sorrow and clamor into comedy, the multicolored screen proves even more adept than the dreamscape at constructing what we call "beauty." But once the laughter ends, then what?

quotes.title: About Yao Guang
quotes.text: I had long heard that the Xianzhou holds etiquette in high regard, but the gift General Yao Guang presented upon our first meeting... is surely far too valuable. As for her intentions, even with "tuning," I find them hard to discern.

quotes.title: About Himeko • Nova
quotes.text: She has shown me the true qualities of a pathfinder. The fulfillment of a dream is never a solitary endeavor, for only by passing the torch can we truly light up the boundless night.

quotes.title: About Robin • Summeretto
quotes.text: Before I knew it, Robin had already paved her own path. It's about time I devoted myself fully to the path ahead as well. Regardless of how twisted this path of pursuit may be, may we always be able to move closer together.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: The "Dozing General" of the Xianzhou Luofu... I've heard a lot about him, but I feel he doesn't do anything... He's not as good as the lady general from our Xianzhou Yaoqing.

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: He's so young, but a Cloud Knight Lieutenant already!? Could he have a Ma more strict than mine urging him on with swordplay?

quotes.title: About Fu Xuan
quotes.text: I think about this every time I listen to Diviner Fu talk. We are both from Xianzhou, but are we really speaking the same language?

quotes.title: About Yukong
quotes.text: I've heard Cloud Knight veterans talk about the legend of the "Starfire Fox." As the best ace pilot in the Luofu, Madam Yukong's starskiff records remain unbeaten! I didn't expect her to talk in such a polite way when I met her~

quotes.title: About Tingyun
quotes.text: I saw Tingyun in so many shops and just thought she was a customer who's always buying stuff... Then I heard all those shops are hers!

quotes.title: About Qingque
quotes.text: She's the girl playing in the games parlor, right? She must have played for years to be that good... With how good her skills are, it's almost a martial art for her.

quotes.title: About Luocha
quotes.text: That outsider looks weak, but is pretty brave. If he weren't on the Xianzhou and hadn't met me, he'd totally get robbed just for lugging such a huge case around.

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: Bailu... I—it's that Healer Lady. I heard that her crying can cure patients... that sounds impossible! But she is a Vidyadhara after all... for them, the more outrageous something is, the more possible it becomes.

quotes.title: About Jingliu
quotes.text: "One sliver of moonlight, nine hundred lives" — in Mr. Xiyan's stories about Jingliu, I love this sentence the most. How come the Cloud Knights' records didn't say anything about such a swordmaster...?

quotes.title: About Guinaifen
quotes.text: I think Little Gui's talents would go unappreciated in a lot of settings... Being a street performer is her true calling!

quotes.title: About Xueyi
quotes.text: She might be tougher than flesh and blood, but not being able to feel pain...? I don't think that's a good thing.

quotes.title: About Huohuo
quotes.text: I don't know how exactly, but Huohuo manages to keep that Tail of hers in check, even though she's terrified of heliobi... It proves she's got some serious talent!

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: Seems like "Silent but Deadly" has caught the eye of a fair few heavy hitters. So does that mean he's a big fish, now? Maybe one day I'll get to hear his story.

quotes.title: About Jiaoqiu
quotes.text: Uncle J... Oh, it's like this — I didn't like sword fighting class when I was a kid, so I would sneak away and visit him. He taught me how to read and how to write his name, but his name was too hard for me, so he just let me call him Uncle J... Eventually he stopped teaching me how to write and just made me all kinds of delicious food, until my mother dragged me by the ear back to sword lessons.

quotes.title: About Moze
quotes.text: That name sounds familiar... Oh! One time when I went to Uncle J's house, I saw someone hiding on the roof... Maybe it was him!

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: I see THEIR glances in your memories. I see all the choices you've made on your journey, as well as your lively and astonishing... essence. Without a doubt, I'll always, always... follow you and the steps you leave behind in the cosmos.

quotes.title: About Acheron
quotes.text: If I could dance with that enchanting lady, then perhaps I would bow before her charms. Ahh~ That would be so... SO beautiful...

quotes.title: About Black Swan
quotes.text: That arrogant woman? I may shy away from her pretentious airs, but as a Memokeeper, her ability to open doors for fate and create resplendent memories... is something I cannot help but admire.

quotes.title: About Firefly
quotes.text: The Stellaron Hunters are meant to be prisoners to the "script," yet she rebelled against fate time and time again... When will her blaze finally burn away the past which the Swarm has buried?

quotes.title: About Duke Inferno
quotes.text: His ambitions were doused by a sudden rain, and the glance of the never descended. None will remember his death... except me. I do not remember him out of guilt or sorrow. I just... can't forget the look in his eyes when he finally learned the truth.

quotes.title: About Jade
quotes.text: Using a mere paper contract to bind two parties... Should I call it naivety, or does a poisonous serpent truly hide under that woman's petals? Perhaps that's why the strange fragrance one picks up when entangled with her... feels so irresistible.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: You always manage to pull out something new every time I'm on the verge of losing interest in you. Are you doing that on purpose? Maybe, just maybe, you know what makes me tick.

quotes.title: About Ruan Mei
quotes.text: Every time I heard that her experiments failed, I'd rush over ASAP and congratulate her with the utmost sincerity — there's nothing more precious than failures for a genius.

quotes.title: About Screwllum
quotes.text: He's better than me in logic and finesse. I'm better than him in talent and achievements. We stand toe-to-toe in taste and dress. Therefore, in conclusion, we're equals.

quotes.title: About Asta
quotes.text: Asta is an outstanding manager. Someone less skilled would have already let us geniuses ruin more than ten space stations.

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf
quotes.text: Who? Oh, that young lady who loves to prank. I'll remember her name when she finally understands the game that adults play.

quotes.title: About Himeko
