quotes.text: I've always thought that the coffee I make is fitting for high-intensity scientific research, but Himeko really trumped me on that front — I admit defeat in terms of innovative coffee brewing.

quotes.title: About Welt
quotes.text: He has sharp eyes. He's not actually near-sighted, right? Those who like to wear glasses often conceal themselves behind those lenses. Pity I don't have a lot of free time — otherwise I'd like to pry into his past, too.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: The general is a true master of maximizing returns for minimal effort. I cannot match him on that front.

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: I once gifted him some items I deemed rare, and that child respectfully thanked me and accepted them. Then I saw him excitedly selecting swords in the Artisanship Commission... Hehe, children are clever little creatures.

quotes.title: About Yukong
quotes.text: Whether it's driving starskiffs or leading the Sky-Faring Commission, Madam Yukong is always present in the Xianzhou's course. I'm still lacking in my skills as a helmswoman.

quotes.title: About Luocha
quotes.text: A businessman from beyond the sky? And he's not on the Whistling Flames' records... Weird, why can't I remember him?

quotes.title: About Sushang
quotes.text: Sushang is very kind and comes to my shop every day to ask: "Is business difficult? I'll help you!" "Did anyone smash your shop? I'll help you!"...

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: Lady Bailu has small hands but is very skilled... I have to go lie down and have a massage with her every time I return to the Luofu.

quotes.title: About Qingque
quotes.text: I just thought she was a frequent customer of the games parlor, but recently I heard she is a diviner from the Divination Commission... Aren't they always busy over there? How can she have the time for a games parlor?

quotes.title: About Fu Xuan
quotes.text: The master diviner has a harsh tone, but she speaks sense. To be completely honest, her lectures are quite memorable...

quotes.title: About Mengming
quotes.text: Nowadays Mengming manages everything in and out of the tea house. People say "Foxians are born to do business," but things are always easier said than done.

quotes.title: About Numby
quotes.text: They've always liked shiny things — gold coins, gems, you name it. They're like a big fat investment account accruing interest... Guess I should've just named them "Piggy."

quotes.title: About Aventurine
quotes.text: In the IPC — no — even just the Strategic Investment Department — there are plenty of unsavory characters I don't care for. They may be my colleagues, but we're not the same. Take Aventurine, for instance... I sincerely hope you never have to deal with him.

quotes.title: About Bronya
quotes.text: The supreme guardian of Belobog... Well, she's an impressive little girl well beyond her years in maturity... Huh? You're saying I'm about her age? No, no, no, totally different circumstances, no comparison at all...

quotes.title: About Himeko
quotes.text: I've heard about Himeko of the Astral Express — my colleagues were gossiping about how beautiful and knowledgeable she is. If I ever get the chance, I'd love to meet her.

quotes.title: About Pom-Pom
quotes.text: The most mysterious character on the Astral Express is that conductor — the one who looks like a little creature... Their reputation precedes them. If they're as interesting as the rumors suggest, I'll definitely have to meet them sooner or later! And hopefully, I'll get to pet them too!

quotes.title: About Asta
quotes.text: Lady Asta! Now that's a real lady if I ever saw one. You'll never guess just how wealthy she really is!

quotes.title: About the Stellaron Hunters
quotes.text: Stellaron Hunters? We aren't acquainted. Never worked with them on any projects. Supposedly those guys are hard to get in touch with, but they have an unexpectedly good credit record — which I value far more than any groundless conspiracy theories.

quotes.title: About Jade
quotes.text: Lady Jade is like nobility to me, beautiful and capable. She is always so kind and willing to guide and support the younger generation! When I think about the first time I met her, I still get nervous... Time does fly.

quotes.title: About Pearl
quotes.text: Pearl never gets upset. She'll first use impeccable logic and data accurate to 20 decimal places to make sure you don't get upset. Any meeting she's attending will definitely NOT erupt into arguments.

quotes.title: About Aventurine • Waveflair
quotes.text: You don't actually believe he's there on vacation and filming commercials, do you? For a workaholic like him to willingly take a trip to Astropolis, there must be some treasure he's dying to get his hands on, one he'd rather not draw attention to.

quotes.title: About Aglaea
quotes.text: Agy... She's not as cold as she seems on the surface. Look, our clothes were sewn by Agy! But her passion and attention must mostly be focused on her ideals of genesis, leaving little left for other things.

quotes.title: About Phainon
quotes.text: Snowy... It always feels like he's carrying too much. Not just his own wishes but also the hatred and expectations of others... Though we all have our own missions, I still get worried... Bearing everything alone is not a good habit.

quotes.title: About Mydei
quotes.text: Anyone who thinks De only knows how to fight is greatly mistaken! In terms of strength, he's number one. In terms of military strategy and history, he's also number one! I'm really good at teaching people!

quotes.title: About Castorice
quotes.text: Cas is always alone — when she's lost or sad or even when she's happy. We want to hug her and tell her it's okay. But no matter how close we get, she always feels so far away...

quotes.title: About Anaxa
quotes.text: Naxy talks about so much weird stuff every time I see him. His words make my head spin... But if he doesn't talk like that, then it kinda feels odd...

quotes.title: About Hyacine
quotes.text: Cinny has always helped us against our deterioration, and it's not just her medicines that work wonders. We get super re-energized every time we see her smiles that are as warm as sunshine!

quotes.title: About Cipher
quotes.text: Ciphy always said that she hates rules and restraints, but we've always known that she's a good kid. She'd cry for us, and she would help people without a second thought... She may never admit it, but the weight of the Flame-Chase Journey never left her mind...

quotes.title: About Hysilens
quotes.text: Big Sis Hysilens often hummed songs of the sea for us, keeping us company through the lonely days. When we miss her, we'd go listen to the conch she left behind...

quotes.title: About Cerydra
quotes.text: The Imperator's speeches might sound extreme to most Amphoreans, but we saw how she spent days on end staring at the chessboard, neither eating nor drinking, lost in thought over the road ahead. It's those quiet moments unseen by the world that made us choose to stay...

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: Little Gray, do you still remember the help Tribios received? It turns out that it was Miss March helping us! Your Trailblazing companions really live up to their reputation!

quotes.title: About Dan Heng • Permansor Terrae
quotes.text: Dan Heng is like a silent star in the night sky that's not keen to draw attention to itself. But we know very well that, should a star want to illuminate other stars, it must be capable of unimaginably explosive powers!

quotes.title: About Cyrene
quotes.text: At the very end, we really managed to reach the end of the west wind, where flowers bloom in spring... But it's not a vague "prophecy." It's a paradise built with all the memories Reney and everyone else experienced again and again.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: March is curious about everything, and she's always getting me to do combat poses. She thinks I pull them off pretty well, apparently. You think so too? Hmm...

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: He's safe. I know he has his doubts... but he's one of the crew now. Himeko and I won't let anyone harm him.

quotes.title: About Himeko
quotes.text: Himeko's the kind of person that... gives off her own light. Even though we're traveling across the train's old route, you can see Himeko's dreams flashing before her eyes when you look at her. It's almost as if she's been on the train from the very beginning — always moving starward.

quotes.title: About Pom-Pom
quotes.text: Pom-Pom's always there to lend a helping hand, but I'd refrain from teasing them if I were you. The last person that did that...

quotes.title: About Dan Heng 2
quotes.text: There is a quote I like very much that I would like to share with him: "The galaxy is vast beyond compare, containing an infinite number of possibilities. An individual's fate shouldn't be limited to a single path ordained by heaven."

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: Having an ideal and pursuing it is not rare, but being able to start anew after that ideal is shattered — this kind of willpower will carry him far.

quotes.title: About Fugue
quotes.text: In the face of the seemingly unstoppable tide of destiny, we always have the freedom to resist... She must have fought an extremely tragic but heroic battle against herself.

quotes.title: About The Herta
quotes.text: The world is full of extraordinary complexity. Normally, researchers are only able to glean truth after dissecting the universe into categories... yet she revealed the essence of all things in such a miraculous way. If I hadn't seen it with my own eyes, I would never have believed it.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng 3
quotes.text: Growth might look like just taking one step forward, but it can only be completed after finishing a long journey. I am relieved to see how much more determined the light in his eyes has become.

quotes.title: About March 7th 2
quotes.text: Since experiencing this trip — or perhaps much earlier — March has become a mature Nameless. We needn't treat her like a helpless child anymore.

quotes.title: About Himeko • Nova
quotes.text: I always knew Himeko was full of surprises, but the beauty of the "Starblazer" far exceeded my expectations. Still, I must clarify: The charm of a giant robot isn't just about its looks. Without a doubt, it's her dream that gives it that final, brilliant finishing touch.

quotes.title: About Hanya
quotes.text: My sister is tasked with the karmic interpretation of people's memories. She works relentlessly in the Hall of Karma — it's a thankless job with no "rest days..." I can see the dark circles around her eyes.

quotes.title: About Huohuo
quotes.text: Only 38 years have passed since Huohuo joined the Commission as a spiritfarer, but she's already become a judge. The speed of her promotion is unheard of. As per the Commission's rules, it would have taken anyone else at least 500 years.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: When I was alive, Dan Feng's reputation preceded him. To witness him now — an ousted criminal under a different name... How the world changes.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: The general has proved to be a staunch ally of the Ten-Lords Commission. His loyalty will be rewarded.

quotes.title: About Luocha
quotes.text: As an outsider capable of mending my mechanical body, he's far from typical...

quotes.title: About Jingliu
quotes.text: Just like me, she carries the burden of guilt. But, unlike me, she doesn't have the chance or need to atone for her wrongdoings, which has led her down a dangerous path.

quotes.title: About Tail
quotes.text: Back then, I tried to dissuade my little sister from her actions. But now, I can see how it provided the Ten-Lords Commission with many opportunities.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: The general has no need to show his martial prowess with me around. Since he acknowledges my strength, I need to help shoulder his burdens that much more!

quotes.title: About Tingyun
quotes.text: Tingyun would ask me to write introductory pieces for blades when her Codex on Goods contains a section on them.

quotes.title: About Sushang
quotes.text: Sushang has a good sword, but a good sword is not always an easy-to-use sword. One needs to apply ten times more power to make it perform just one-tenth better.

quotes.title: About Yukong
quotes.text: I visited the Sky-Faring Commission once and saw Madam Yukong staring alone at the leather target for a long time. She didn't fire a single arrow that day, but perhaps she did shoot thousands in her mind.

quotes.title: About Fu Xuan
quotes.text: So, Diviner Fu wants to be the general... Well, firstly, she needs to fix the issue where everyone just wants to nap as soon as she starts to talk.

quotes.title: About Luocha
quotes.text: At first, I thought he always fights using that sword casket. That thing looks really strange... I need to figure out a way to fight him and get him to use his skills for real...

quotes.title: About Jingliu
quotes.text: I used to think there was only one way to become a true swordmaster... but General, Jingliu, and even myself... we all ended up on different paths.

quotes.title: About Dan Heng
quotes.text: When I fought Dan Heng, his spear mastery was almost perfect... but he was completely detached from it as an art. Maybe for him it's just a means to an end?

quotes.title: About Blade
quotes.text: He can detect any swing of the sword before it lands... Would I be able to defeat him with my swordplay alone?

quotes.title: About Guinaifen
quotes.text: I remember her... One time she was carrying a beautiful sword, so I thought I'd strike up a conversation. But then she swallowed the sword down her throat! To this day I still haven't figured out which sword-fighting style that technique is from...

quotes.title: About Yunli
quotes.text: I heard that Miss Yunli was a great swordmaster, so I thought she'd be a good sparring partner, but... she's always eyeing my sword, so I better be careful.

quotes.title: About Jiaoqiu
quotes.text: I always take Doctor Jiaoqiu's sensational stories with a grain of salt... Some people like to call him a weirdo, but the truth is he's experienced a lot of things that I couldn't even imagine...

quotes.title: About Lingsha
quotes.text: Even though I don't understand politics, I know that Cauldron Master Lingsha's job is quite difficult. The general also told me to do my best to assist her in re-organizing the Alchemy Commission.

quotes.title: About Feixiao
quotes.text: I learned a very important lesson from General Feixiao: Before taking action, be like a rock and wait for the enemy to move first. While taking action, be like lightning and move faster than anyone else. After taking action, be like a fire and leave no hidden dangers untouched.

quotes.title: About (Trailblazer)
quotes.text: Your future does not lie within my sight, but rather beneath your own feet. As for that little secret... Well, only the heavens, the earth, and you know. I know nothing of it.

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: People say I'm always competing with the Divine Foresight, but little do they know we're just being honest with each other. Superficial harmony won't help the Xianzhou's development. If someone needs to play the stalwart to stir up these still waters and spark a grand competition of a hundred ships, then I'll gladly take on that role.

quotes.title: About Fu Xuan
quotes.text: Ah, my dear junior soror... Even when she comes to report to the Yuque, she doesn't stay a day longer than necessary, insisting on returning right on schedule. She used to love competing with me when she was little, but now her rival has become that General of the Luofu... even though I knew her first.

quotes.title: About Fugue
quotes.text: They say foxians from the merchant guild are good at going whichever way the wind blows, but her rudder stays remarkably steady. Speaking up for the common folk, calling out the Aeons' injustice... That kind of boldness is rare, and I like it.

quotes.title: About Sparxie
quotes.text: That girl is like a firecracker, always catching people off-guard. If she were willing to make some mischief with me... Hmm, we could definitely accomplish things no one's done before.

quotes.title: About Himeko
quotes.text: She keeps her edge hidden and doesn't draw attention to herself... Even you know very little about her past, don't you? But everyone must return to where they started at some point in life, and from there, embark on a new journey.

quotes.title: About Sunday
quotes.text: A Xianzhou General roping in Penacony's former top brass? Sounds unbelievable, doesn't it? But that's exactly the kind of "unpredictable" twist I'm after. As for what surprises lie ahead... Well, we'll just have to wait and see.

quotes.title: About Qingque
quotes.text: Many spend their whole lives chasing their dreams, but she alone knows that "ignorance is bliss".. hey, don't laugh. That's actually an essential quality for becoming a General.

quotes.title: About Feixiao
quotes.text: The Merlin's Claw acts as the talons of The Hunt. "Eyes" without "talons" are weak, and "talons" without "eyes" are blind. She loves hearing my ideas, and I trust her commands. Although every time she gives me fitness advice — telling me to ditch the peacock dance for the sparrow fist — she's giving me a bit too much credit.

quotes.title: About Jingliu
quotes.text: I don't mind her utilizing the remnants of the Propagation, burning the golden blood of the Destruction, or even borrowing the power of the Abundance itself. It's just that the picture she's painted, unfortunately, has yet to fully convince me.

quotes.title: About Ashveil
quotes.text: Some people's futures are like the trajectory of a bullet, never able to turn back, forever doomed to fly in a singular direction until they pierce their enemy's heart.

quotes.title: About Silver Wolf LV.999
quotes.text: Back in the day, I was good at mathematical calculations, loved having fun, and worked in intelligence... Could I have been a hacker just like her? I'd really love to face off against her in a match.

quotes.title: About Evanescia
quotes.text: She's got a whole trove of tall tales about the arcadia to share... But no matter how absurd they sound, considering this is Planarcadia we're talking about, I'm more than happy to nod along to every word.

quotes.title: About Mortenax Blade
quotes.text: See? Planarcadia is a place where fates collide, where people fight to live through death. With what he's become, the Xianzhou now stands a better chance of victory. As for him being a former Luofu criminal... I'd say that merits and faults balance each other out, don't you think?

quotes.title: About Himeko • Nova
quotes.text: If you're looking to collaborate, Himeko is exactly the kind of reliable partner you want by your side. Keeping your ace in the hole until the very end... not everyone has the nerves for that. So tell me, what kind of surprises does "The Trailblaze" have in store for us next?

quotes.title: About Pearl
quotes.text: Madam Pearl's construction method and level of thinking do have some aspects worth referencing for the Deca-Light Reflection Barrier. Say, if I were to switch to a mechanical body myself, would that take me to the next level?

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: The general may behave slovenly, but he has plans for all the affairs of the Xianzhou.

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: A sword will vibrate and beg to be unsheathed if it is unused for too long... Once unsheathed, it will either paint the battlefield in blood, or break itself in the process...

quotes.title: About Tingyun
quotes.text: The Xianzhou need brawny warriors with their swords and spears, as well as unpredictable waters like her who travels freely and unrestrained.

quotes.title: About Sushang
quotes.text: She is indeed reckless, but she is also passionate and eager. Don't underestimate her. Youth can accomplish a lot simply by relying on such energy.

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: Though Bailu has been worshiped as the High Elder since birth and had no say in this, her title of Healer Lady was indeed gained from her expert practice of medicine.

quotes.title: About Jingliu
quotes.text: You should not mention this name... it has been a forbidden word for a long time.

quotes.title: About Qingni
quotes.text: Qingni picked the road she yearned for, just like her mother. There's no reason to feel remorse... It makes me wonder, who's really grappling with regrets?

quotes.title: About Feixiao
quotes.text: Feixiao won't show any weakness to anyone. The fact that she sometimes chats with me about her feelings already counts as relaxing for her.

quotes.title: About Fugue
quotes.text: In my heart, she has always been that child who yearned for the many worlds across the vast universe. She has always been... Tingyun.

quotes.title: About Huaiyan
quotes.text: Grandpa always treats me like a child. But come to think of it, at his age, who isn't a child to him?

quotes.title: About Jing Yuan
quotes.text: Every time I hear Grandpa and General Jing Yuan talking, I start to fall asleep. Why can't they speak to each other the same way they talk to me? I can never understand conversations between generals...

quotes.title: About Yanqing
quotes.text: He has so many great swords that he never uses. Sometimes, I can hear those swords crying... Is this what people mean when they say "spoiled for choice?"

quotes.title: About Feixiao
quotes.text: I prefer to make friends by sparring — after all, combat is more sincere than words. That carefree general of the Yaoqing is the same as me in that regard.

quotes.title: About Moze
quotes.text: Ah yes, General Feixiao has a counselor by that name. I've heard that it's very, very difficult to see him, unless he reveals himself willingly. But usually he's nowhere in sight...

quotes.title: About Jiaoqiu
quotes.text: He always asks me to go eat hot pot with him. I know it's delicious, but I just can't eat that hot and spicy stuff.

quotes.title: About Lingsha
quotes.text: Whenever I'm on the Zhuming and I have time, I go visit Lingsha and Ardens Regia. Then, when I'm tired of playing, I rest my head on her lap... Lingsha always has this sweet sweet aroma about her.

quotes.title: About Blade
quotes.text: You mean Yingxing? I've never met him in person, but Grandpa has mentioned him countless times. He's probably one of his most famous apprentices... I'd love to chat with that Shard Sword of his if I get the chance.

quotes.title: About Bailu
quotes.text: The Luofu's high elder? I once got to share a table with her in Aurum Alley. We ate tons of scallion chicken and fried rice balls. We even exchanged numbers and agreed to come back to Aurum Alley for a big dinner sometime.

quotes.title: About March 7th
quotes.text: March is my first apprentice. She's talented and willing to put in the work — I'm quite pleased with her. If I could just hear her say that my teaching is better than Yanqing's, I would be over the moon.

quotes.title: About Huohuo
quotes.text: That Judge from the Ten-Lords Commission? She doesn't seem like a warrior, but that tail of hers has some fight in it.

quotes.title: About Qingque
quotes.text: Qingque has the guts to grab March away right in front of me and go play Celestial Jade... but I can see she has experience. March might be able to learn a thing or two from her and apply it to her swordsmanship.

quotes.title: About Argenti
quotes.text: After we got to know each other by sparring, I realized that he was indeed a kind gentleman, but it was a little hard to understand him... And his "sword" was hard to understand, too...
